Introduction to the job

This role focuses on software‑oriented troubleshooting and problem-solving on PAS5500 / RH / YS systems—including stages, handlers, Illumination and all other module and system levels. 
Unlike traditional software development roles, this position centers on Linux-based control systems, C# / C++ control logic analysis, execution sequence, algorithm, motion behavior diagnostics, signal tracing, and system-level issue resolution. 

As a 3rd-line Production Engineer, you will proactively identify issues, define clear technical problem statements, and collaborate closely with D&E to drive structural fixes. 
Your daily work involves analyzing control logic behavior, IO interface anomalies, memory/communication issues, error tables, signal inconsistencies, and automation sequence problems to ensure stable factory operations and prevent repeat occurrences. 

This position is ideal for engineers who enjoy hands-on system debugging, motion/control problem analysis, and cross-functional technical collaboration, rather than full-time coding. 

Role and responsibilities

Software & Control Troubleshooting

Diagnose and analyze issues within Linux-based control systems, including C# / C++ control logic, automation sequences, and motion behavior. 

Perform signal tracing, log analysis, power/signal path checks, and interpret position/velocity/acceleration curves from motion control loops. 

Identify root causes across software behavior, IO timing, memory patterns, PCB interactions, electrical noise, or mechanical coupling. 

3rd-Line Technical Problem Solving 

Proactively identify production issues and define structured problem statements for D&E. 

Support escalations and collaborate with D&E on MDEV / MTD investigations, engineering changes, and structural solutions. 

Provide expert-level deep dives when 1st/2nd-line support has exhausted troubleshooting paths. 

Production Support & Structural Fixes

Ensure stable factory execution for PAS5500 / RH / YS mechatronics modules. 

Analyze error tables, software logs, automation sequences, and motion profiles to prevent repeat failures. 

Drive data collection, experiment setup, validation of hypotheses, and structural improvement implementation. 

Documentation & Diagnostic Improvements

Maintain, update, and optimize procedures, diagnostic methods, work instructions, and software/motion debugging guides. 

Identify process gaps related to diagnostics or control behavior and create new procedures or sequences where needed. 

Lead improvement projects and deliver measurable impact on factory stability and troubleshooting efficiency. 

Required Qualifications

Education

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Automation, or related technical fields. 

Technical Skills

Experience with Linux-based control systems. 

Proficiency in C# and/or C++, especially for understanding and analyzing system control logic (not application-level coding). 

Familiarity with: Motion control fundamentals (position/velocity/acceleration loops) /Automation control theory /IO interfaces, communication protocols, and memory behaviors /PCB basics, schematic reading, and signal/power tracing 

Strong analytical and logical reasoning skills for root cause analysis. 

 

Problem-Solving

Experience with system-level debugging, control logic analysis, or automation/machine troubleshooting. 

Ability to translate ambiguous system symptoms into clear, structured technical problems.

Cross-functional Collaboration

Ability to work closely with D&E, presenting technical findings and participating in deep-dive engineering discussions. 

Capable of delivering technical presentations during interviews (topic assigned by hiring manager). 

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with semiconductor equipment, precision motion systems, automation machinery, robotics, metrology, or stage control systems. 

Familiarity with real-time control, EtherCAT, PLC interactions, embedded Linux, or automation controllers. 

Hands-on experience with sensor/actuator integration or motion tuning. 

Exposure to ECN, MDEV/MTD methods, or structured root cause analysis processes. 

Ability to design controlled experiments and interpret complex logs to support structural fixes.

Introduction to the job 

ASML’s Production Engineer Team in Linkou supports the mature product portfolio—including PAS5500, YieldStar (YS), Reticle Handler (RH), and XT—with over 450 engineers across electrical, software, mechanical, mechatronics and system specialties. 

The team combines the strengths of Development & Engineering (D&E), Manufacturing, and Customer Support to ensure stable factory output, rapid issue resolution, and structural improvements across mature system generations. 

As a Production Engineer (Electrical & Control), you will focus on electrical system behavior, PCB-level diagnostics, electrical cabinet components, signal/power integrity, high-voltage and safety circuits, and motion-related electrical issues that impact system performance. This role is hands-on, system-oriented, and highly collaborative with D&E to drive structural solutions and prevent repeat failures. 

Role and responsibilities

Electrical System Troubleshooting & Analysis 

Diagnose electrical issues across PAS5500/YS/RH/XT modules, including electrical cabinets, power distribution, PCB boards, sensor/actuator wiring, and safety circuits. 

Perform PCB-level diagnostics: schematic reading, signal tracing, component-level fault isolation, protocol checks, and power/signal path verification. 

Investigate electrical noise, grounding issues, shielding problems, HV behavior, emergency interlock loops, and safety circuit abnormalities.

Motion & Automation Related Electrical Issues 

Analyze electrical failures in motion subsystems (stage/handler) involving sensor feedback, actuator behavior, wiring inconsistencies, or noise-induced distortion. 

Interpret motion profiles (position/velocity/acceleration curves) and work with S&C/mechatronics engineers to identify electrical contributions to system failures. 

3rd-Line Engineering & Structural Fixes 

Collaborate with D&E on deep-dive engineering investigations, structured root cause analysis, and implementation of corrective/structural solutions 

Define clear technical problem statements and guide investigations after 1st/2nd-line teams have exhausted initial troubleshooting paths. 

Support ECN implementation and ensure corrective actions eliminate systemic electrical issues. 

Documentation & Diagnostic Improvements 

Maintain and enhance schematics, cabinet documentation, electrical diagnostic procedures, and troubleshooting guides. 

Identify diagnostics gaps and propose new test procedures, tools, or workflows to improve electrical problem detection and system reliability. 

Lead improvements that enhance system stability and production troubleshooting efficiency. 

Required Qualifications 

Education 

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in: 

Electrical Engineering 

Electronics Engineering 

Mechatronics / Automation 

Or related disciplines 

Technical Background 

3–5 years in electrical engineering domains, such as: 

PCB design/debug, electronic circuits, motion-control-related electrical systems, automation machinery, or semiconductor equipment. 

Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics and perform PCB failure analysis. 

Knowledge of communication interfaces, signal integrity, grounding, electrical noise, and power distribution. 

Familiarity with high-voltage safety, interlock circuits, and emergency loop behavior. 

Understanding of motion control fundamentals and sensor/actuator integration. 

Strong analytical skills for solving complex electrical/system-level issues

Preferred Qualifications 

Experience with semiconductor tools, automation machinery, robotics, or precision motion systems. 

Hands-on experience with electrical cabinet integration, power system design, or safety circuit troubleshooting. 

Familiarity with signal/power integrity analysis, EMI/grounding mitigation, or motion feedback analysis. 

Exposure to engineering change processes, structured root cause analysis methods, or reliability improvement projects. 

Experience designing controlled experiments and interpreting complex diagnostic data.

Introduction

The Diagnostics team within Customer Support develops solutions that help service engineers resolve issues quickly in the field. These solutions support the full path from detecting system failures to identifying the root cause and planning the right recovery actions. With thousands of engineers worldwide depending on our tools, the challenge is to ensure that essential information reaches them at the right moment. Your internship will help improve how these diagnostic solutions are shared and adopted across the global service network. By strengthening this communication flow, you will directly contribute to system uptime and customer satisfaction.

Your assignment

You will work on improving how diagnostic solutions are communicated and used by service engineers around the world. The current communication flow relies on key-users, which creates a bottleneck and limits the reach of available solutions. Your task is to design a scalable and practical strategy that fits the fast-paced operational environment of our engineers. Your main responsibilities will be:

Analyze the current communication approach and identify bottlenecks.

Investigate why some engineers do not use existing diagnostic solutions.

Map the information needs of service engineers in operational environments.

Propose improvements that increase awareness and adoption of diagnostic tools.

Design communication methods that reach all engineers without disrupting their workflow.

Create a scalable approach using existing structures such as key-users and media packages.

Embed your strategy into the daily workflow of the global service community.

This is a master's (thesis) internship for a minimum of 5 months, 5 days per week (4 days can be discussed), the team works 4 days on-site. The start date is set at the end of August, starting earlier is possible.

Have strong analytical skills and experience with data analysis

Are proactive and comfortable working with incomplete information.

Have a hands‑on way of working and enjoy solving complex challenges.

Have good communication skills and are fluent in English (written and spoken).

Introduction

The CS Diagnostics team helps our field service engineers solve issues on ASML machines as quickly and accurately as possible. We analyze what goes wrong in the field, how engineers are supported today, and how we can improve that support through better insights. Our work combines error patterns, dashboards, decision steps, and data-driven models to guide engineers toward the right solution. This internship contributes to developing smarter ways to recommend expert rules, reducing investigation time and increasing machine availability. If you want to work on high‑impact problems in a fast‑moving environment, this internship offers a meaningful challenge.

Your assignment

During this internship, you will explore methods to automate the creation of expert rules used by field engineers. These rules help determine the best next action when machine symptoms occur, yet creating them manually is time‑consuming. You will investigate how symptom combinations can be represented, compared, and translated into candidate rules that improve diagnostic decision-making. Your work will contribute directly to faster, more reliable field support. Your main responsibilities will be:

Analyze symptom patterns and define meaningful ways to represent them.

Explore and benchmark multiple methods to search large solution spaces.

Develop metrics to evaluate the quality of proposed expert rules.

Build and test algorithms that recommend suitable candidate rules.

Compare different approaches for efficiency, robustness, and accuracy.

Validate outcomes using real or simulated incident data.

Summarize insights and recommend improvements for implementation.

This is a master's (thesis) internship for a minimum of 5 months, 5 days per week (4 days can be discussed), the team works 4 days on-site. The start date is projected at the end of August, starting earlier is possible.

Your profile

To be suitable for the internship, you:

Are enrolled in a master’s degree in computer science, data science, mathematics, engineering, or a related field.

Are analytical and enjoy solving complex technical problems.

Have experience working with data analysis or algorithm development.

Work in a structured, proactive, and collaborative way.

Communicate clearly in English, both verbally and in writing.

Introduction

ASML US, including its affiliates and subsidiaries, bring together the most creative minds in science and technology to develop lithography machines that are key to producing faster, cheaper, more energy-efficient microchips. We design, develop, integrate, market and service these advanced machines, which enable our customers - the world’s leading chipmakers - to reduce the size and increase the functionality of their microchips, which in turn leads to smaller, more powerful consumer electronics. Our headquarters are in Veldhoven, Netherlands, and we have 18 office locations around the United States including main offices in Chandler, Arizona, San Jose and San Diego, California, Wilton, Connecticut, and Hillsboro, Oregon.

Job Mission

As a manufacturing test engineer, you will perform all factory acceptance tests required to certify a DUV laser system for customer delivery. You will be part of a highly skilled team that tests all lasers for the Cymer Light Source division. Our DUV light source consists of an intricate network of process gases, optics, electronics, high-power electrical, metrology and control systems. In this hands-on position you will have the opportunity to work with all of these components and become a system expert. You will be the key to delivering a quality product through testing, issue identification and resolution, and finding potential improvements.

Duties & Responsibilities

Tests laser systems and validates manufacturing processes. 

Performs functional tests, optical alignment, equipment calibration, station setup.

Recommends changes in design, methods, and procedures to enhance product quality.

Solves problems through troubleshooting and leveraging available resources.

Uses standardized tools and electronic equipment (i.e., torque wrenches, electric and pneumatic screwdrivers and ball drivers, lifting equipment, computers, oscilloscopes) to assemble/install/remove or perform testing and troubleshooting. 

Trains others on areas of test processes and troubleshooting when required.

Performs a variety of moderately complex technical service/support duties requiring specialized knowledge (i.e., sub-assembly, assembly, build, test, R&D, QA).

Utilizes functional area databases to run reports and analyze/trend data; Makes recommendations to management in order to meet production needs.

Interfaces with design engineers to support special tests and experiments with detailed instructions.

Documents and monitors parameters critical to product quality or operations.

Uses specialized test equipment such as leak testing, Hi - Pot and alignment instruments. 

Pressurizes gas and water systems with helium and troubleshoots failures.

Reads and understands business documents such as Bills of Material, routing sheets, inventory records and work instructions.

Maintains a clean work area, and is responsible for designated tools (routine maintenance and calibration).

Installs electrical connectors to modules.

Performs other duties as assigned.

Ability to translate, statistically analyze data, and effectively report problems through written and/or graphical formats.

Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills

Introductie

Word jij enthousiast van techniek en wil jij je ontwikkelen in een omgeving waar het oplossen van complexe storingen in een hightech productieomgeving centraal staat? Werk je graag praktisch én analytisch, en wil je bijdragen aan machines van wereldklasse? Dan is deze functie bij ASML iets voor jou!

ASML is één van de meest vooruitstrevende hightechbedrijven ter wereld en speelt een sleutelrol in de halfgeleiderindustrie. Met onze lithografiesystemen maken we de technologie mogelijk die schuilgaat achter elektronica die mensen dagelijks gebruiken: van smartphones en medische apparatuur tot auto’s en datacenters. Onze kracht ligt in innovatie, samenwerking en technische excellentie.

Binnen ASML Manufacturing zijn we verantwoordelijk voor het introduceren, produceren en leveren van de meest geavanceerde lithografiesystemen ter wereld. Dit doen we in een snel veranderende markt waarin kwaliteit, tijdige levering en kostenefficiëntie essentieel zijn. Vanuit onze fabriek zorgen we ervoor dat machines wereldwijd bij onze klanten perfect functioneren.

Je volgt de kwaliteit, doorlooptijd en voortgang van oplossingen en zorgt dat verbeteringen op tijd en correct worden doorgevoerd.

Je werkt nauw samen met verschillende afdelingen en collega’s op verschillende niveaus binnen de organisatie om problemen goed te analyseren en structureel op te lossen.

Je neemt initiatief, voert actieplannen uit en durft beslissingen te nemen, ook wanneer niet alles vooraf zeker is. In overleg en escalatiemeetings ben je duidelijk en assertief.

Introduction

The EUV Factory is responsible for producing and installing ASML’s advanced EUV systems up to the Site Acceptance Test at customer locations. The Manufacturing Program Management team is responsible for New Product Introductions as well as managing Cycle Time- and Cost targets. In order to do this effectively we use several processes, some officially documented, some became part of our daily work through experience. We want to get a better understanding about what processes are running, with what goals and the effectiveness of these processes.
 

Your assignment

This internship offers a unique opportunity to explore the organization which manufactures one of the most complex machines in the world. Discover how our team operates and take the opportunity to improve our way of working. Your main responsibilities will be:

Map the formal and informal processes used within the EF Manufacturing Program Management team.

Create a stakeholder map to identify which groups are impacted by these processes.

Assess the effectiveness of current processes and identify improvement opportunities.

Document findings in a clear and structured way.

Present outcomes and recommendations to the team.

Support the team in translating improvement proposals into actionable next steps.

This is a bachelor’s or master’s non‑thesis internship for a minimum of 3 months, 3–5 days per week (60% on‑site). The start date of this internship is projected at the end of August 2026. An earlier start is possible.

Your profile

To be suitable for the internship, you:

Are currently enrolled in a bachelor’s or master’s degree in business engineering, industrial engineering, business administration or related.

Have affinity with working in a technical environment

Communicate clearly and enjoy working with a wide range of stakeholders.

Are collaborative, proactive, and comfortable engaging with others in a dynamic environment.

Have strong analytical thinking skills and can work from a high‑level perspective when needed.

Introduction to the role

The DUV Software Group at Cymer is seeking a talented Software Quality Assurance Engineer with experience—and enthusiasm—for complex, real-time control systems. In this role, you will be engaged across the full software development lifecycle, from requirements definition through system-level testing, helping ensure the reliability and performance of cutting-edge industrial products.

 

Role and responsibilities

You will work closely with Systems, Algorithms, and Software engineers to develop clear, testable requirements and translate them into effective test strategies and detailed verification plans. Hands-on work in a laboratory environment—testing laser-based electro‑mechanical systems, analyzing results, and reporting findings—is a core part of the role. Our systems leverage actuators, motors, sensors, real-time operating systems, object-oriented design, and distributed control architectures. If you are a self-starter who enjoys technical ownership, collaboration with world-class engineers, and making a visible impact on small, high-performing teams, we would like to hear from you.

Develops, publishes, and implements test plans for software module and system level test. 

Designs and creates test cases and procedures for testing software functionality, executes these test cases, and maintains an auditable storage and retrieval of test results. 

Analyzes software requirements for completeness, participates in requirements design and code reviews, and participates in collection of operational use cases

Participates in design reviews to ensure requirements have been flowed down into the appropriate design documentation.

Analyzes test results and provides progress reports to engineers and management. 

Works closely with developers to isolate and understand problems and issues.

Collects data on problems and issues and feeds that back to the development teams for implementation of root cause solutions.

Performs other duties as assigned.

 

Education and Experience

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related discipline.

A minimum of five (5) years industry experience in devising and implementing test plans in an embedded environment required.

Past experience in testing hard real time embedded software systems and algorithms for electro-mechanical systems.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to translate, statistically analyze data, and effectively report problems through written and/or graphical formats.

Ability to trace hardware connectivity issues and use basic tools such as oscilloscopes and logic analyzers

Ability to logically think through issues and be able to trace problems and implement quickly creative solutions.

Ability to define and carry out test procedures, improving them (if possible), or move them into the test automation framework.

Ability to define and carry out installation procedures and accurate record keeping of configurations.

Desired experience in the following:

Use Cases, UML, process and data flow.

Software development processes, Software configuration management and defect tracking.

Must have demonstrated a pragmatic and disciplined approach in successfully implementing best SQA practices in a "real world" company. Proven success defining, developing, and implementing software test systems. Past success in testing embedded software systems and algorithms.

 

Other Information

This position is located on-site in San Diego, CA . It requires onsite presence to attend in-person work-related events, trainings and meetings and to further ensure teamwork, collaboration and innovation.

A flexible workplace arrangement may be available to employees working in roles conducive to remote work (up to two days a week).

ASML US brings together the most creative minds in science and technology to develop lithography machines that are key to producing faster, cheaper, more energy-efficient microchips. Develop portions of the lithography system and/or associated tooling and test equipment.

Hand tools

Desarrollar e implementar estrategias de visita médica orientadas a resultados y alineadas con los objetivos del territorio.

Identificar oportunidades de mercado, coordinar actividades científicas y reportar información relevante al área comercial y médica.

Gestionar su territorio con base al cumplimiento de KPIs de Demanda (> rotación, e IE: 100 en DDD y Rx).

Profesional en áreas de la salud, ciencias o administración.

Mínimo de 3 a 5 años de experiencia comprobada en visita médica.

Sólidas habilidades de negociación, planificación y manejo de relaciones interpersonales.

Capacidad analítica, autonomía y liderazgo.

Dominio de herramientas digitales de gestión comercial (CRM, Excel, reportes POWER BI)

Job Description

A day in the life of an Large Loss Contents Property Adjuster:

Spend your day handling claims out in the field.

Handle escalated claims files that have complex contents or additional living expense damages.

Conduct a thorough coverage investigation of the loss and ensure the policy was applied correctly.

Use advanced technology to identify damages and write a contents damage estimate.

Communicate empathetically with customers and help them through their claim process in a fast, fair and easy manner.

Negotiate claim settlements with customers in accordance with business unit standard methodologies.

Coordinate with structure adjusters to ensure holistic handling of the claim file.

Use data and analytics to tell a story and influence decision making.

If offered the role, you will go through virtual training. You will receive ongoing support, mentoring and coaching as you develop your career.

(Preference will be given to those candidates that reside in Philadelphia or surrounding 4 Counties) 

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:

The Customer Service Expert –you’ll live into Allstate’s Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each Property claim. You lead with empathy, always.

The Investigator – you’ll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.

The Effective Communicator – you’ll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. You’ll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.

The Negotiator – You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.

The Problem Solver –you’ll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.

The Recorder – you’ll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained on. You’ll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Schedule:

Monday – Friday; 8 am - 5 pm with rotational weekend duty.

This role involves taking care of customers in their times of need. As a result, you must be willing to work some weekend and extended hours if necessary.

Preferred Qualifications:

3+ years of previous experience handling property insurance claims preferred.

Have prior experience using estimating software like Xactimate for complex contents estimating preferred.

Value providing an effortless customer service experience.

You enjoy the ability to work independently starting your day from home.

View problems and setbacks as opportunities for improvement and look forward to coming up with creative solutions.

Are organized and able to multi-task in a fast-paced environment.

Are known for clear and professional communication – both written and verbal.

Required Qualifications: 

Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements.

Computer literate & typing skills.

You’re provided with comprehensive training:

The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in your day-to-day work.

Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job.

El coordinador de demanda se encarga de generar y analizar la información de ventas de la empresa (KPIs de resultados), así como coordinar y liderar reuniones de demanda local con las áreas SCM, QA MKT y Comercial.

Qué harás:

Coordinar y conciliar los inputs del forecast entre Comercial, Marketing, Supply y Finanzas Garantizar que toda la información ingresada al proceso (promociones, lanzamientos, planes comerciales, proyecciones financieras) sea consistente, esté alineada y sin duplicidades, actuando como punto central de conexión entre áreas.

Analizar en profundidad el comportamiento del pronóstico y sus desviaciones interpretar tendencias, patrones y drivers de la demanda, evaluando variaciones significativas, errores recurrentes y comportamientos atípicos, generando insights claros y recomendaciones para mejorar la precisión del forecast.

Liderar mejoras del proceso de Demand Planning.

Impulsar iniciativas para estandarizar plantillas, automatizar reportes, mejorar la calidad del dato, optimizar la interacción entre áreas y elevar la disciplina operativa del ciclo S&OP.

Preparar presentaciones y reportes ejecutivos para comités y reuniones interfuncionales Construir presentaciones claras, visuales y orientadas a la toma de decisiones, consolidando información compleja en mensajes simples, y presentándola de forma efectiva ante equipos gerenciales y stakeholders clave.

Dar seguimiento a riesgos de inventario derivados del forecast, como Stock at Risk (SAR), Monitorear el impacto del pronóstico en niveles de inventario, identificando posibles excesos, cortos y riesgos de expiración, y coordinando con Supply y Comercial para definir acciones preventivas.

Consolidar y documentar acuerdos clave del ciclo de demanda, registrar decisiones, cambios realizados y compromisos asumidos por las áreas durante el proceso de consenso, asegurando trazabilidad y claridad en la evolución del forecast.

Conocimiento de Excel a nivel avanzado.

Inglés a nivel intermedio.

Deseable conocimiento de Power BI.

ASML is looking for an ambitious talent who can play a crucial role in the supply chain processes related to ASML’s newest cutting-edge machines. You will prepare and manage the customer supply chain of upgrades and installs close to/in the factory of ASML’s customers.

ASML’s supply chain department is continuously aiming to better serve ASML’s customers, by, for example, providing complex upgrade services at the site of our customers. During these events (a significant) part of the machine is replaced by modules that allow for e.g., increased output and enhanced specifications. These on-site upgrade activities create extremely demanding requirements for the supply chain processes, driven by the sensitivity of the parts (cleanroom handling only), the strict needs to minimize machine downtime and the constantly changing specifications of machines. Goal is to establish a true “field factory” set-up that allows the engineers to perform the installation with maximum efficiency and minimum downtime.

All these processes ultimately enable ASML’s customers such as Intel and Samsung to continue improving the performance of the laptops, tablets and smartphones that we all use.

Contribute to the project team to ensure that the high-tech materials and modules are delivered on-time, on-spec and at the right quality at the customer site. Meet the delivery requirements that have been agreed with the customers and ASMLs engineering team. In between install and upgrade events: initiate and drive continuous improvement to optimize supply chain costs.

Introduction to the job

Do you want to work on hands‑on engineering challenges in an international environment? Join ASML and become part of a growing team of Upgrade, Install and Relocation (UIR) engineers working on the newest EUV machines across Europe. In this role, you build and integrate our systems at multiple customer sites, within specifications, on time, and with quality exceeding customer expectations.

ASML develops, produces and sells high‑end lithography systems for the semiconductor industry. Our machines enable the creation of ever‑smaller, faster and more affordable chips. As a UIR Engineer, you work on the most advanced lithographic systems—machines that operate with accelerations greater than fighter jets and image billions of nanostructures per second.

Role and responsibilities

Training program (Year 1 – International)

Due to the complexity of EUV machines, you begin with a one‑year international training program in Europe, the USA and/or Asia. This includes:

Hands‑on technical training on EUV systems.

Several multi‑week training blocks abroad.

On‑the‑job training at customer sites in Europe or worldwide.

UIR Engineer responsibilities (Year 2 onward)

You will execute installation, upgrade, and relocation projects for EUV systems at customer locations in Europe. Customer fabs are currently located in Ireland and Belgium, with potential sites in Israel, Germany and more.

You will participate in the full UIR end‑to‑end process:

1. Project preparation

Implement lessons learned, prepare customer fabs, pre‑check materials.

Review execution documentation and support continuous improvement projects.

Perform pre‑install actions to ensure all factory conditions are met before machine arrival.

2. Hardware phase

Disassemble systems and execute upgrades.

Work with cabling, water, gas and vacuum components.

Power on systems and perform commissioning checks.

Diagnose and resolve hardware, electrical, gas and water‑related issues.

3. Recovery phase

Integrate and qualify the system.

Calibrate and test system performance, including system acceptance tests.

Diagnose and resolve system failures before handover to the customer support team.

4. Wrap‑up

Finalize documentation and administrative closure of the project.

Operational responsibilities

Perform structured problem analysis, gather diagnostics, and determine solution paths.

Hand over advanced issues to 2nd line support with proper documentation (work orders, field service reports, SPRs, technical reports).

Execute reinstallations, upgrades, hardware installation and system setup/recovery for upgrade packages.

Train customers in routine use and maintenance of equipment.

Flexibility and self‑steering ability.

Introduction

Our Mechanical Engineering team ensures that ASML machines operate reliably in demanding environments. Optical fibers inside these machines are fragile and need protection against damage and external influences. Protective hoses, also called jacketing, play a key role in this process. Currently, there is no clear guideline on which hose types to use in different situations. During this internship, you will help create clarity and improve reliability across ASML systems.

Your assignment

You will research protective hose solutions and develop a proposal for their use within ASML. This includes analyzing current practices, exploring external options, and defining critical parameters for selection. Your main responsibilities will be:

Investigate which protective hoses are currently used within ASML.

Research available hose types, suppliers, and best practices outside ASML.

Define critical parameters and use cases for protective hoses (e.g., twisting, strain limitation).

Compare and evaluate options based on defined parameters.

Develop a proposal for hose selection for different situations at ASML.

Document findings and recommendations in a clear, structured report.

Impact on Cost of Goods

This is a bachelor’s or master’s internship for minimum 3 months, minimum 3 days per week (3 days on-site). The start date of this internship is as of September, 2026.

Your profile

To be suitable for the internship, you:

Are pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in mechanical engineering.

Have analytical skills and enjoy investigating technical solutions.

Are proactive and able to work independently.

Communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with different stakeholders.

Have an interest in mechanical design.

Introduction
The Metrology and Machine Control (MX) cluster develops supervisory control, modeling, and optimization algorithms for the Twinscan platforms. The internship includes exposure to our Metrology Leveling domain, where we measure and model wafer height with nanometer precision to enable high‑quality lithography. You will collaborate with Leveling engineers to understand the necessary domain knowledge. Throughout the assignment, you will contribute to improvements where the ASML and customer will benefit from. This gives you a hands‑on opportunity to experience how Leveling teams work on supporting customer value.
 

Your assignment

Our current patching approach requires stopping most software processes before applying updates. In contrast, MX software is not tightly coupled to real‑time hardware, which opens opportunities to patch software without interrupting hardware activity. A previous internship delivered an initial version of a fast patching tool to support this workflow.
In this internship you will continue developing this tool to make it more robust, scalable, and ready for production. Your work will contribute directly to reduced downtime and more efficient software maintenance. 

Your main responsibilities will be:

Expand the tool to support a wider range of software updates.

Improve the tool to handle lower‑level software changes.

Add checks to validate the contents and safety of each patch.

Increase the reliability and robustness of patch execution.

Improve code quality and prepare components for production use.

Collaborate with engineering experts to gather user needs and test results.

This is a bachelor/master regular internship for a minimum of 3 months but preferably 6 months , 5 days per week (3 days on‑site). The start date of this internship is as September 2026 (but earlier is possible).

Introduction

The Optical Column department at ASML develops the imaging systems used in YieldStar, a leading optical metrology tool for overlay measurement. These measurements help ASML’s customers improve the yield of their semiconductor manufacturing processes. To enhance product performance, the team continuously monitors key indicators and links them to design parameters. As an intern, you will contribute to this effort by analyzing and improving optical system models.
 

Your assignment

This internship gives you the opportunity to work with advanced imaging system models and contribute to performance analysis and design improvements. You will collaborate with experienced architects and engineers in the Optical Column department to simulate, analyze, and optimize optical modules.
 

Your main responsibilities will be:

Develop simulation models for optical modules using MATLAB.

Create tools for imaging simulation and performance prediction.

Analyze model behavior and link it to optical design specifications.

Formulate hypotheses for design improvements.

Apply experimental design methods to validate your hypotheses.

Recommend hardware or functional enhancements based on your findings.

Present your results and maintain clear documentation of your work.
 

This is a master’s internship (non-thesis) for minimum 6 months, 3–5 days per week (2–3 days on-site). The start date of this internship is as soon as possible.

Are solution-oriented, analytical, and have a hands-on approach.

Communicate effectively in English, both verbally and in writing.

Introduction to the job

ASML US brings together the most creative minds in science and technology to develop lithography machines that are key to producing faster, cheaper, more energy-efficient microchips. We design, develop, integrate, market and service these advanced machines, which enable our customers - the world’s leading chipmakers - to reduce the size and increase the functionality of their microchips, which in turn leads to smaller, more powerful consumer electronics. Introduction to the job

ASML US brings together the most creative minds in science and technology to develop lithography machines that are key to producing faster, cheaper, more energy-efficient microchips. We design, develop, integrate, market and service these advanced machines, which enable our customers-the world’s leading chipmakers-to reduce the size and increase the functionality of their microchips, which in turn leads to smaller, more powerful consumer electronics. Our headquarters are in Veldhoven, the Netherlands, and we have 18 office locations around the United States including main offices in Chandler, Arizona, San Jose and San Diego, California, Wilton, Connecticut, and Hillsboro, Oregon.

As our Upgrade Install and Relocation Engineer, you will be part of a team of engineers who help our Customer Support (CS) organization install, repair and maintain ASML systems at customer sites. You ensure that our chipmaking systems work as they should – and be part of the technology innovation that’s moving the world forward.

Roles and responsibilities

In this role, you’ll be a technical specialist who is expected to calibrate and qualify the machine on site, according to a pre-defined test-sequence similar to the tests that have previously been performed in Veldhoven. You will work with co-workers, and the customer in isolating and solving problems, as well as acting as a resource for users on routine malfunctions. You’ll be responsible for performing administrative and coordination duties, including pass-downs, work orders, field service reports, system problem reports, and monthly reports, as well as preparing written technical reports on an independent basis.

You’ll report to the Senior Team Lead, but you’ll also be part of the larger Customer Solutions & Support sector – where the in-fab installation and optimization of ASML products happens.

As an Upgrade Install and Relocation Engineer, you’ll:

Assemble and qualify the machine on site, according to procedure in a pre-defined sequence.

Build, install and align components to a complete machine.

Install ASML equipment at customer locations, including equipment with new features, pilot and proto systems.

Analyze applicability, accuracy and adherence to design specifications.

Recommend design changes or substitution of materials when appropriate.

Evaluate and diagnose problems and make appropriate repairs.

Work with co-workers and the customer in isolating and solving problems.

Answer customer questions and assist customers in a professional manner.

Provide if appropriate support and assistance to less experienced ASML or local personnel as necessary.

Perform complex adjustments, perform upgrades, diagnose and solve problems with limited support.

Prepare written technical reports if required.

Education and experience

Job Grade 04:

Bachelor’s degree in a technical field or the equivalent combination of education, skills and experience will be considered. 

An associates or technical degree with at least 2 years of technical experience will be accepted. 

Job Grade 05 - 06:

Bachelor's degree in an Engineering field or equivalent combination of education, skills and experience.

Minimum 2+ years' experience in semiconductor industry preferred. 

Minimum 2+ years' Field Service Engineer work experience preferred.

Minimum 2+ years' experience in using computer applications, including data analysis tools, word processing, spreadsheet, and presentation software preferred.

Knowledge of the semiconductor industry, vacuum system, or plasma is preferred.

Introduction

The Mains & Safety team within Development & Engineering plays a key role in designing safety‑critical handling systems for ASML’s lithography machines. These systems must perform reliably under a wide range of conditions to support system uptime and product quality. This internship supports that mission by improving how we validate the reliability of I/O modules returned from the field. You will help the team strengthen diagnostic capability while contributing to lower environmental impact and reduced Cost of Goods. This is a chance to gain hands‑on experience in a highly innovative and international environment.

Your assignment

You will design and implement a complete testbench that combines hardware and software to verify the safety, performance, and functional integrity of PLC‑based I/O modules. Your work will help ensure consistent, repeatable, and traceable testing that supports automated decision‑making on module reuse or replacement. You will also deliver clear documentation and present your findings to the team.

Your main responsibilities will be:

Design and build a hardware setup that supports safe and repeatable I/O module testing.

Develop software that measures key electrical and communication parameters.

Create automated pass/fail classification and reporting tools.

Validate the testbench under different operating conditions.

Analyze test results and support root‑cause investigations.

Document the full methodology and write a clear technical report.

Present your approach, results, and recommendations to the team.

This is a bachelor/master thesis internship for 3-6 months, 5 days per week (min. 3 days on‑site). The start date of this internship is as of September 2026, however starting earlier is possible.

Your profile

To be suitable for the internship, you:

Are a bachelor’s or master’s student in electrical engineering or a related degree.

Have practical experience with PLC hardware and TIA‑Portal.

Are analytical and comfortable working with measurement and verification methods.

Enjoy building structured solutions and automating manual processes.

Work collaboratively and take a proactive approach to problem‑solving.

Other requirements you need to meet:

You are enrolled at an educational institute for the entire duration of the internship;

Attach your cover letter with a clear motivation why you are interested in this internship assignment in particular;

You need to be located in the Netherlands to be perform your internship. In case you are currently living/studying outside of the Netherlands, your CV/motivation letter includes the willingness to relocate.

If you are a non-EU citizen, studying in the Netherlands, your university is willing to sign the documents relevant for doing an internship (i.e., Nuffic agreement).

岗位职责 / Responsibilities
负责客户现场光刻工艺的技术支持，包括工艺开发、优化、参数设定与问题诊断；Provide on-site technical support for lithography processes, including process development, optimization, parameter setup, and issue diagnosis.
深入理解客户产品与制程需求，提供定制化的光刻解决方案；Deeply understand customer products and process requirements to deliver customized lithography solutions.
分析并解决光刻过程中出现的工艺问题，如曝光均匀性、对准精度、CD控制、Overlay误差等；Analyze and resolve lithography-related process issues such as exposure uniformity, alignment accuracy, CD control, and overlay errors.
协助客户进行新产品导入（NPI）过程中的光刻工艺验证与调试；Support customers in lithography process verification and tuning during new product introduction (NPI).
编写并维护技术文档，包括工艺流程、问题分析报告、技术交流材料等；Prepare and maintain technical documentation, including process flows, issue analysis reports, and technical communication materials.
与总部研发、产品、FAE团队协作，推动工艺技术的持续优化与创新；Collaborate with headquarters R&D, product, and FAE teams to drive continuous process improvement and innovation.

The First Line Support Production Engineer is responsible for providing first-line troubleshooting support to ensure uninterrupted production output. This role requires hands-on troubleshooting of production issues, escalating issues when necessary, and driving continuous improvement through documentation, analysis, and collaboration. The Production Engineer First Line Support has an understanding of product SPC (Statistical Process Control), manages disturbance notifications, and works with the internal teams to support Material (MN) and Disturbance (DN) review boards, ensuring optimal product flow and minimal disruptions.

This position will be 3rd shift M-F 10:00pm-7:00am

Core Responsibilities 

First-Line Troubleshooting & Problem-Solving 

Spends 75% of time in the Cleanroom supporting production processes and leading troubleshooting actions 

Provide real-time troubleshooting support for production issues to minimize downtime and optimize output. 

Document all disturbances and resolutions accurately for future learning. 

Escalate issues to senior FLS when resolution cannot be achieved independently. 

Capture learnings from troubleshooting efforts and use them to write & enhance OCAPs (Out of Control Action Plans). 

Execute ‘As New’ based on input and documentation from D&E/Module PE to ensure product quality meets defined standards. 

Perform ‘cherry picks’ to select and evaluate specific parts for quality and process validation. 

Escalation Management & Technical Documentation 

Create ETPs (Engineering Test Plans), task lists, and DOs (Disturbance Orders) related to escalation management, tooling maintenance, and troubleshooting. 

Advancing problem resolution through detailed investigation of recurring issues. 

SPC Tracking 

Support and maintain SPC tracking for tooling and products, ensuring data-driven process control. 

Disturbance Notification Analysis, Material Notifications & Process Improvement 

Perform pre-DRB activities as directed by Technical Lead or equivalent. 

Support, maintain, and execute by participation in the DRB/MRB (Disturbance Review Board/Material Review Board) process. 

Create and manage E-Scraps for scrap parts to ensure traceability and accountability. 

Participate in continuous improvement initiatives and projects. 

Educational Requirements and experience

A Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical, Electrical or Mechatronics engineering with 2+ years of experience in a production engineering environment

Masters Degree in Mechanical, electrical or Mechatronics engineering and prior internship experience within a production environment

Prior experience troubleshooting mechanical, and or electro-mechanical parts

Key Skills & Qualifications 

Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills. 

Ability to pick up structured problem-solving methodologies. 

Exposure to SPC and data-driven process control. 

Ability to document technical issues and resolutions clearly. 

Effective collaboration with cross-functional teams. 

Exposure in escalation management and technical documentation. 

Familiarity with quality processes

Introduction

The Image Alignment EUV group is a collaborative team of metrology specialists who work together to achieve highly accurate alignment of patterns from reticle to wafer. We study machine behavior in detail and translate our insights into models and measurement sequences that run in the scanner software. Our work spans all EUV systems operating in the field today as well as the next‑generation platforms, creating a dynamic and forward‑looking environment.

Our team develops and maintains several calibration actions that keep the scanner performing at its best. These actions complement each other to position the reticle in the optimal object plane and the wafer in the optimal image plane, ensuring every pattern is projected precisely onto the correct location on the silicon wafer. We derive corrections to stage and lens positions from sequences of sensor measurements and model the misalignments detected, accounting for effects such as thermal drift and system behavior over time.

Your assignment
You will explore population data from EUV systems to reveal how multiple calibration actions relate to one another. You will help extend existing dashboards and analytical tools so the team can better understand scanner behavior and improve image alignment performance. You will also contribute to recommendations that support higher accuracy and stability.
Your main responsibilities will be:

Analyze population-level data to uncover calibration dependencies.

Design and implement dashboard extensions that highlight interactions between actions.

Develop or improve scripts that generate data for visualization.

Validate your analytical approach with clear, structured testing.

Summarize findings and propose improvements to scanner behavior.

Document your methods and results for knowledge transfer.

This is a master’s internship for a minimum of 6 months, 4-5 days per week (2 days on‑site). The internship is scheduled to start in September 2026, but an earlier start date is possible.

Your profile
To be suitable for the internship, you:

Are enrolled in a master’s degree in statistics, data science, applied physics, engineering, or applied mathematics.

Have experience programming in MATLAB or Python.

Understand object‑oriented programming principles.

Can analyze and visualize data using platforms such as Spotfire.

Are analytical, collaborative, proactive, and comfortable communicating in English.

Other requirements you need to meet:

You are enrolled at an educational institute for the entire duration of the internship;

Attach your cover letter with a clear motivation why you are interested in this internship assignment in particular;

You need to be located in the Netherlands to be perform your internship. In case you are currently living/studying outside of the Netherlands, your CV/motivation letter includes the willingness to relocate.

If you are a non-EU citizen, studying in the Netherlands, your university is willing to sign the documents relevant for doing an internship (i.e., Nuffic agreement).

Introduction to the job

ASML’s Production Engineer Team in Linkou supports the mature product portfolio—including PAS5500, YieldStar (YS), Reticle Handler (RH), and XT—with over 450 engineers across electrical, software, mechanical, mechatronics and system specialties. 

The team combines the strengths of Development & Engineering (D&E), Manufacturing, and Customer Support to ensure stable factory output, rapid issue resolution, and structural improvements across mature system generations. 

As a Production Engineer (Optics), you will focus on optical module preparation, alignment, calibration, troubleshooting, and system-level optical behavior that impacts factory output. This role emphasizes hands-on optical module diagnostics, problem-solving, production support, and close collaboration with multidisciplinary engineering teams to drive structural improvements and prevent repeat failures. 

Role and responsibilities

Optical Module Troubleshooting & Analysis 

Diagnose optical issues across PAS5500/YS/RH/XT modules, including illumination paths, imaging modules, optical sensors, interferometric components, and alignment/calibration fixtures. 

Perform optical alignment checks, optical path inspection, contamination evaluation, and basic interferometric or reflective diagnostics. 

Investigate light source stability issues, optical throughput variations, imaging behavior deviations, sensor accuracy concerns, and calibration failures. 

Optics-Related Production Support 

Support factory integration activities involving optical modules, lens assemblies, optical stages, scanning/measurement submodules, and sensor-based calibration processes. 

Execute optical calibration sequences and assess calibration result quality. 

Provide clear containment actions to minimize machine downtime and secure stable production output. 

3rd-Line Engineering & Structural Fixes 

Collaborate with D&E (Optics/Mechatronics/S&C) on deep-dive investigations into optical behavior deviations or sensing inconsistencies. 

Define accurate technical problem statements and support structured root cause analysis (RCA). 

Contribute to ECN implementation and ensure solutions resolve structural optical issues. 

Documentation & Diagnostic Improvements 

Maintain and enhance optical diagnostic procedures, calibration workflows, and troubleshooting guides. 

Identify diagnostic gaps and propose improvements in test steps, alignment checks, or optical evaluation criteria. 

Improve documentation clarity to support both Manufacturing and Customer Support. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration 

Collaborate with Mechanical, Electrical, Software & Control, Mechatronics, and D&E optical teams to verify findings and drive issue resolution.

Communicate effectively with global stakeholders and ensure proper escalation paths are followed.

Education 

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in: 

Optics / Optical Engineering 

Applied Physics (with optical specialization) 

Photonics 

Electro-Optical Engineering 

Optical Science / Optical Technology 

Or other optics-related disciplines. 

Technical Background 

3-5 years of experience in one or more of the following: 

Optical module assembly, integration, alignment, or calibration 

Optical testing/measurement (laser alignment, imaging, interferometry basics, illumination systems, optical sensors) 

Troubleshooting optical modules or sensing components in precision equipment.

Hands-on experience with optical benches, alignment tools, microscopes, or optical inspection equipment.

Understanding of fundamental optics principles: reflection/refraction, imaging basics, tolerancing, alignment sensitivity, contamination effects.

Additional expectations: 

Ability to interpret optical measurements and identify abnormal system behavior.

Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills for optical/system‑level issues.

Experience supporting production, manufacturing engineering, or equipment troubleshooting.

Understanding of mechanical–optical interactions and tolerance stack‑up behavior.

Exposure to engineering change processes, structured RCA, or reliability improvement initiatives. 

Basic scripting (MATLAB/Python) for optical data analysis is a plus, but not required.

Configure machines for autonomous production and active process monitoring.

Audit automated processes to ensure consistency and prevent systematic part defects.

Create and fine-tune CAM-generated code to optimize feed rates and speeds for maximum automated efficiency.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams including production, quality, metrology, and equipment maintenance to resolve technical challenges and implement sustainable solutions

Document and maintain process specifications, work instructions, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) to ensure knowledge retention and standardization

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Optical, Materials, or related field)

Minimum 5 years of experience in optical fabrication process engineering or a related manufacturing environment

Hands-on experience with optics fabrication techniques, including CNC machining, polishing, and surface inspection

Demonstrated machine operation and CNC programming experience

Solid Modeling Software, NX preferred

CAM Software, Mastercam preferred

CNC Operating Systems – Siemens, Winmax, Fagor, Fanuc

Proficient in statistical process control (SPC), root cause analysis (RCA), and lean manufacturing tools

Introduction

Join the Machine Data & Infrastructure (MDI) department at ASML, where we define and manage machine input settings for advanced lithography systems. These settings enable customers to structure wafers and ensure accurate processing. To speed up adding new settings, we developed a data-driven Code Generator using Xtext and Xtend. However, these technologies are nearing end-of-life, and we need your help to explore alternatives. This internship offers you the chance to contribute to a critical migration project that impacts multiple teams across ASML.
 

Your assignment

You will investigate and evaluate modern technologies to replace Xtext and Xtend in our Code Generator. Your work will help us prepare for future-proof solutions and reduce dependency on outdated frameworks.
 

Your main responsibilities will be:

Research and identify alternatives for Xtext and Xtend

Compare options using predefined evaluation criteria

Select the most suitable technology for migration

Demonstrate feasibility by migrating part of the current implementation

Explore automation strategies for full migration, possibly leveraging AI

Document findings and provide recommendations for next steps
 

This is a master (thesis) internship for a minimum of 6 months, minimum 5 days per week (3 days on-site). The start date of this internship is as of as soon as possible
 

Your profile

To be suitable for the internship, you:

Are pursuing a master's degree in computer science

Have experience with multiple programming languages (preferably Java and C++)

Understand or have experience with domain-specific languages (DSLs)

Are analytical, proactive, and able to work independently

Communicate clearly and enjoy learning new technologies
 

Other requirements you need to meet:

You are enrolled at an educational institute for the entire duration of the internship;

Attach your cover letter with a clear motivation why you are interested in this internship assignment in particular;

You need to be located in the Netherlands to be perform your internship. In case you are currently living/studying outside of the Netherlands, your CV/motivation letter includes the willingness to relocate.

If you are a non-EU citizen, studying in the Netherlands, your university is willing to sign the documents relevant for doing an internship (i.e., Nuffic agreement).

Introduction

ASML US brings together the most creative minds in science and technology to develop lithography machines that are key to producing faster, cheaper, more energy-efficient microchips. We design, develop, integrate, market and service these advanced machines, which enable our customers - the world’s leading chipmakers - to reduce the size and increase the functionality of their microchips, which in turn leads to smaller, more powerful consumer electronics. Our headquarters are in Veldhoven, the Netherlands, and we have 18 office locations around the United States including main offices in Chandler Arizona, San Jose and San Diego California, Wilton Connecticut, and Hillsboro Oregon.

Job Mission

ASML Wilton is seeking a highly motivated Senior EH&S Specialist who will provide technical assistance in the development and implementation of Workplace Health & Safety Programs. The Sr. EH&S Specialists will play a key role in maintaining compliance, the incident reporting and analysis process and work closely with supervisors and engineers to develop and implement corrective actions preventing recurrence. With the committed support of ASML Management, it promotes a culture focused on safety and injury prevention to maintain and implement best practices for a comprehensive EH&S Management System.

Responsibilities

Improve EH&S performance by promoting an incident-free workplace, identifying and mitigating safety risks and implementing safety programs.

Development and implementation of programs and procedures to ensure compliance with applicable Federal, State, and Local occupational safety standards and ASML Corporate requirements.

Conduct compliance audits and guide teams with implementing corrective actions to ensure compliance.

Conduct risk assessments such as hazard assessments, ergonomic assessments, etc. as needed to reduce workplace injuries.

Assist with safety incident investigations, work with key stakeholders to develop root cause analysis, and identify corrective actions.

Project coordination implementation of actions which drive continuous improvement. Verify the appropriateness and effectiveness of action plans associated with incidents JSA’s and audit findings.

Support Hazardous Substances Management Program (new chemical approval, SDS updates, quarterly audits, exposure calculations, in-house hazardous chemical container labeling).

Create Toolbox Talks and informational presentations and effectively deliver to operational teams you will support.

Be a key influencer to improve overall safety culture.

Data collection and analysis.

Routine internal reporting (weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual updates).

Conduct business with the highest ethical standards and demonstrate decision-making skills that ensure the safety of all persons associated with ASML operations.

Other relevant duties as assigned.

Education, Knowledge, and Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Environmental / Occupational Health & Safety or related field of study.

Master’s degree is a plus. 

Experience: 3+ years of work experience as an Environmental, Health and Safety professional.

Professional License or Certification (ASP, CSP, CIH, etc.) is a plus.

Knowledge and understanding of Federal, State, and Local regulations.

Advanced applied knowledge of health and safety programs including LOTO, Electrical Safety, Working at Heights, Hazard Communication, Crane and Hoist, Confined Space, Walking and Working Surfaces, Lasers, Machine Guarding, Hazardous and Highly Toxic Gases, etc.

Knowledge of NFPA 70E and CFR 1910.331 – 1910.335, Electrical Safety.

Knowledge of CFR 1910.302 – 1910.308, Design Safety Standards for Electrical Systems.

Ability to assess and audit various workplace environments for potential hazards and effect corrective action.

Good interpersonal, communication and organizational skills are essential.

Ability to work independently and in a team environment.

Ability to effectively prioritize under dynamic conditions.

Ability to work flexible and/or varied shifts to ensure safety coverage as needed.

Excellent troubleshooting/problem solving skills; “solutions oriented”.

Proficient skills and effective use of Microsoft Office applications.

Introduction
 ASML is a high-tech company and leading supplier to the semiconductor industry. We manufacture complex lithography machines used by chip manufacturers to produce integrated circuits or computer chips. It is essential that ASML's property, plants and equipment, buildings, real estate and services are maintained at a consistently high level to realize our growth targets. The Corporate Real Estate (CRE) organization is a centralized department that is responsible for CRE activities worldwide, serving more than 40,000 employees.

Role and responsibilities 
 As part of Corporate Real Estate (CRE) team, the Hard service specialist will be responsible to manage the Hard services (Facility infrastructure specifically mechanical, cleanroom, gas, HVAC, and other technical building systems) across the CRE Korea region that delivers the Asset Management and Facility Maintenance outsourced services. It would be mainly focused on the ASML owned facilities including cleanrooms. Hard service specialist ‘s core task is to ensures high reliability of facility assets, supports business continuity, works closely with IFM (Integrated Facility Management) service provider, and drives long term asset performance improvements.

 In collaboration with the procurement & sourcing team (s)he ensures the necessary capacity and capabilities in the supplier base and monitor their performance. (S)He drives continuous improvements with the suppliers. (S)He defines budgets, create forecasts and approve expense. Focus on the financial- & performance management, and contract development. 

 As the Asset management specialist, (s)he is responsible for the establishment of the Long-Term Asset Maintenance Plan, and also defines the asset maintenance project portfolio for next year, ensure funding, and drive the execution of the approved asset maintenance projects in the running year. (S)he manages a portfolio of studies that originate from operational disturbances or incidents where proper preventive actions need to be investigated and defined, and works closely with the CRE EHS and the Asset Safety managers to optimize the execution of planned asset maintenance activities without effecting business continuity. As part of the Projects team, (s)he will contribute to continuously improve the asset management standards and methods.

Job Task
• Create / Update the Long Term Asset Maintenance Plan(LTAMP) plan.

Manage the LTAMP-process cycle, included relevant improvement projects.

Use all available asset management data, the priority model and de input from stakeholders to create a balanced 10-year plan.

• Work out detailed Asset Maintenance Project Year Plan

Translate the LTAMP to a more concrete and detailed project portfolio for the next year.

Define the funding requirements for this project portfolio.

Ensure proper administration of project proposals and execution.

• Manage the execution of surveys (condition assessment, insurance, risk assessment, asset inventory, etc.)

• Ensure and define technical competencies for each utility and facility
• Manage the portfolio of studies that originate from operational disturbances or incidents that required 3rd line support and proper investigation or study.
• Develop and maintain a comprehensive system for performance management and metrics to monitor supplier performance and contract-compliance.
• Manage and deploy contracts, maintain contracts through changes.
• Coordinate and follow up with supplier on execution of non-standard service requests.

Manage the cost forecasting and budgeting process; set-up and maintain the relevant processes and templates.

Based on annual activities plans, create, monitor, justify, maintain, adjust the annual financial plan (budget) and forecasts per service line.

Manage supplier reporting process (availability of reports and dashboards).

The HR Well-being team at ASML is dedicated to supporting employees in maintaining their health, engagement and sustainable performance within a highly demanding, fast-growing high-tech environment. ASML’s success depends on highly skilled professionals who operate under continuous innovation pressure, making employee well-being essential for retention, productivity and long-term business success. Job Description

As a Upgrade Install and Relocation (UIR) engineer, you will be responsible for the end-to-end installations, upgrades and relocations adjustments, calibrations, qualification of ASML lithography tools, and customer communication. This role requires a multidisciplinary engineering background and hands-on experience with complex semiconductor equipment in cleanroom environments.

Key Responsibilities

Execute installation and qualification of ASML lithography systems including mechanical, electrical, and software integration.

Perform system troubleshooting, diagnostics, and root cause analysis to resolve installation issues.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams worldwide including project coordinators, system owners, technical support teams and customer representatives to ensure timely and successful system delivery.

Support continuous improvement initiatives for effective installation from preparation through execution to wrap-up including tooling.

English – Fluent or Native level

Japanese – Intermediate or above

Trustworthiness

Respect and care on team members and stakeholders.

Strong communication and documentation abilities in both English and Japanese.

Proactive, professional behavior and curiosity to grow

Flexibility to travel and work in a dynamic, high-tech environment.

Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.

Remark

You will work at any customer site across Japan and possibly the world. Business trip to other sites can occur 50-90% of your life.

As a Field Service Engineer (FSE) of ASML Semiconductor equipment (Lithography), You will support the customer with operational equipment support, performance monitoring, mechanical/pneumatics/electrical/optical repairs/servicing, and maintenance.

Collaborate with co-workers and customers in isolating and solving problems.

Take lead to maintain the local SOP/SPS/BKM WOW in Fab Team

Initiative-taking and flexibility

Working experience in tsmc Fab is welcome.

Introduction to the job

As a Finance business process expert, you help shape the next generation of ASML’s finance processes. You will contribute directly to ASML’s mission by designing scalable, automated and future-proof service accounting flows that support global growth. In this role, you will work on the foundation in SAP S/4HANA and the finance data model, ensuring our systems and processes keep pace with ASML’s fast-expanding business.

Role and responsibilities

As a Finance business process expert, you act as the hands-on specialist who defines, builds and improves finance processes with a strong focus on service accounting. You take ownership, lead decisions and collaborate closely with finance, IT and architecture teams to ensure successful transformation.

Your responsibilities include:

Design and build end-to-end finance processes for SAP S/4HANA, with a strong focus on service accounting.

Drive improvements in performance management using best practices in processes, data structures and technology.

Work with finance teams, business process owners and business and IT architects to translate business needs into system designs.

Lead and support adoption of new processes by explaining, testing and validating solutions with end users.

Embed internal controls in process designs and support automation initiatives.

Ensure alignment between finance processes, master data and the finance data model.

Contribute expert knowledge during ERP migration activities and help shape future standards.

Education and experience

You bring a strong background in finance operations, service accounting and SAP-based process design.

You have:

A bachelor’s or master’s degree in finance, accounting, business administration or a related field.

8–10 years of experience in finance process design, service accounting or financial operations.

Deep knowledge of SAP finance solutions (SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA).

Experience with complex business processes, preferably in the service order flows, contracts and billing domain.

Familiarity with automation tools such as RPA.

Experience with ERP migrations and finance transformation initiatives.

Knowledge of SAP revenue accounting (RAR) is a plus.

Skills

Working at the cutting edge of tech, you’ll always have new challenges and new problems to solve – and working together is the only way to do that. You won’t work in a silo. Instead, you’ll be part of a creative, dynamic work environment where you’ll collaborate with supportive colleagues. There is always space for creative and unique points of view. You’ll have the flexibility and trust to choose how best to tackle tasks and solve problems.

To thrive in this job, you’ll need the following skills:

Communicate complex finance and -system topics in a clear and structured way.

Build strong relationships and collaborate effectively across finance, IT and business teams.

Take ownership and lead decisions with confidence.

Show a proactive and curious mindset, always seeking process improvements.

Adapt quickly to change and guide others through transformation.

Apply strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

Stay focused on delivering results in a dynamic environment.

Other information

You will join the Transformation & Digital Finance department and report to the Team Lead Business Process Experts. This position is based in Veldhoven and may require limited travel. Context

The Customer Support (CS) organization is responsible for the installations, qualification, repair and maintenance of the ASML systems at customer sites and is responsible for the necessary transfer of know-how to the customer. Local site Customer Support branches perform these tasks for the customer within the specific region.

Anticipates, analyzes and solves complex technical problems escalated from first line support or the customer including in-fab support as needed. Conducts diagnostics and troubleshooting with a higher degree of independency and under limited supervision within primary competency.

Has more specialized knowledge of one competency or broader knowledge of multiple competencies. Has knowledge of and experience with the different components of the machine. Focuses on acquiring more knowledge.

Requirements

BS degree in relevant Technical Field (Electrical Technology, Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, etc.) with thorough experience, or comparable thinking and working level. Experience in semiconductor industry required.
Specialized knowledge in the area of pneumatics, hydraulics or electronics, and semiconductor processes, and relevant software.
Experience in using computer applications, including data analysis tools, word processing, spreadsheet, and presentation software.
Has specialized knowledge of competency/subsystem, product functionality.

Responsibilities

Problem analysis and approach

Gather all information relevant for the problem, analyze using available means, gather additional diagnostic info if needed, decide on initial approach to solve problem, assess new information and adapt approach if necessary under limited supervision.

Issues require basic understanding of primary competency relation to elements of the Service Level Agreement (SLA) including availability/uptime, MTBI, throughput/productivity, and yield.

Problem handovers and routing

Handover problem or problem aspects to others (Sr. TSEs or 3rd line support), document, package and deliver all data relevant for problem resolution (e.g. pass-downs, work orders, field service reports, system problem reports, technical reports).

Repairs 

Advise customer technical personnel and 1st line support in dealing with complex problems, use tools, replace parts, improve settings, to execute repairs including supporting non-routine service actions.
