As a B2B Sales Account Executive, you will proactively sell AT&T’s mobility solutions and fiber-based broadband network to small and mid-market businesses. Client Engagement: Understand the communication and technology needs of small and mid-sized business customers. Present tailored growth opportunities and efficiencies to both current and potential clients.

Bilingual Relationship Building: Use your bilingual skills to build relationships and deliver outstanding service to Spanish-speaking clients.

Account Development: Develop new accounts and expand existing ones by establishing and nurturing long-term relationships with customers.

Consultative Selling: Utilize consultative selling skills to overcome objections, identify key trends, uncover customer needs, and leverage industry knowledge to find and close sales opportunities.

Proposal Development: Craft responses for Requests for Proposals (RFPs) and present products and services that can benefit customers.

Strategic Initiatives: Design and implement strategic initiatives to grow and retain the revenue stream of assigned complex accounts, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction.

What you’ll need:

Hunter Mindset: A relentless drive to seek out leads and close deals, coupled with resiliency and perseverance.

Networking and Negotiation Skills: Strong ability to network and negotiate effectively.

Valid Driver’s License: Must have a valid driver’s license with a satisfactory driving record, current auto insurance, and a reliable vehicle to meet the transportation needs of the market.

Sales Targets: Demonstrated ability to meet and/or exceed assigned sales targets.

What you’ll bring:

Sales Experience: 2-5 years of outside sales and/or B2B sales experience, with a preference for outside telecommunications sales.

Technical Knowledge: Experience and knowledge in fiber broadband technology and mobility products and services.

Sales Funnel Management: Proficiency in managing sales funnels and previous experience with CRM systems.

Language Skills: Bilingual fluency in Spanish required.

Build a more connected world by bringing innovative products and services to life for millions of customers. As part of our Product Management team, you’ll drive the vision, development, and success of solutions that shape how people and businesses stay connected, informed, and empowered.

Job overview

You’re the champion who turns market opportunities into real-world solutions. As Lead Product Management and Development, you’ll guide products from initial concept to launch—and beyond—ensuring every detail aligns with customer needs and AT&T’s business objectives. You’ll manage the full product lifecycle, own the business case, and partner across teams to deliver high-quality, high-impact offerings. Your strategic insight and leadership will fuel growth, innovation, and customer value.

You will have the opportunity to be part of critical transformation in our consumer broadband space. You will lead the product planning for broadband transformation initiatives & operational program execution. You will work closely with our Network, Technology, and Marketing organizations to define targeted transformation plans and then execute on those plans.

What you’ll do

Manage the end-to-end product lifecycle, from ideation through development, launch, and retirement—ensuring seamless transitions and continuous product performance.

Translate customer and technical requirements into actionable product designs, business cases, and detailed documentation including user stories and acceptance criteria.

Conduct thorough market research and competitive analysis to uncover trends, customer segments, and opportunities for new products or enhancements.

Develop and maintain detailed product roadmaps, service guides, and project plans, driving initiatives that grow revenue and margin.

Collaborate closely with business, technology, UX, and 3rd party partners to design or modify products, ensuring exceptional user experiences and cross-functional alignment.

Negotiate with vendors to optimize product cost, features, and support, and work with internal teams to develop effective pricing strategies.

What you’ll need

Expertise in full product lifecycle management, including budgeting, business case development, and P&L ownership.

Knowledge of following technologies & concepts: RAN technologies, deep understanding of cellular networks performance, especially with fixed wireless, Mobility and Broadband product lines, measuring the customer experience across products.

Requires skills to identify, monitor and analyze internal (e.g. financials, customer movement) and external (e.g., wireless technology, competitive) performance parameters and take actions based on those insights.

Advanced skills in market research, competitive analysis, and translating insights into actionable strategies.

Proficiency in crafting technical and customer requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.

Proven ability to develop and maintain complex product roadmaps and project plans.

Strong collaboration skills with experience working across technology, UX, business, and vendor teams.

AT&T has an opening for a Design Engineer (Campus Area Network/Local Area Network (CAN/LAN)): To support our government customer’s global enterprise networks. The CAN/LAN service network architecture provides solutions for modernizing network components while supporting service delivery for customer requirements in a mission-focused operational enterprise. Our team is completely replacing a global enterprise network while providing design, engineering, and transition for a wide range of customer network requirements. This is a unique and rare opportunity to build and transition critical operations to a modern service provider network architecture.

Description of Job Duties/Responsibilities: This position requires office presence a minimum of 5 days per week and is only located in the location(s) posted. No relocation is offered.

Interpret customer requirements and apply standard design approaches for service delivery. Fully document designs with diagrams, bill of materials, cabling sheets, configurations, and other supporting documents.

Use our private test lab to evaluate new technologies and capabilities, test proposed changes to production networks, and recreate troubleshooting scenarios to support the production enterprise network.

Schedule maintenance windows for migrating user connections from legacy to the modern infrastructure transition services with little to no impact on critical data flows.

Provide technical expertise to Operations engineers and technicians, supporting fault isolation and resolution. Solve tough problems with innovative and scalable solutions.

Develop secure network designs including configurations that align with Defense Information Security Agency (DISA) Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs) and enterprise policies. Obtain Authority to Operate (ATO) for new devices, software, and capabilities.

Supervise (not manage) other network support specialists to plan, coordinate, and implement network services.

Develop and improve design products, processes, and systems for our team to work efficiently and effectively.

Although this position is focused on CAN/LAN, this opportunity offers the ability to learn and work on Multiprotocol Label Switching (MPLS) Wide Area Networks (WANs). 

Required Clearance: TS/SCI with polygraph. (#ts/sci) (#polygraph)

Required Qualifications: Candidate must have 16 years of experience that can be a combination of work history and education. This equates to a Doctorate and 8 years, master’s and 10 years, bachelor’s and 12 years, associates and 14 years or HS diploma and 16 years. Required qualifications include the following:

Must be compliant with DoD 8140 Information Assurance Technical (IAT) Level 2.

Experience specific to network engineering to include Tier III or higher network operations and/or network design and implementation.

Prior responsibility for production network hardware configurations for Cisco, Brocade, and/or Juniper.

Hands-on experience implementing and troubleshooting standard routing protocols in a production network, such as Open Shortest Path First (OSPF) or Border Gateway Protocol (BGP)

Hands-on experience implementing and troubleshooting standard switching and trunking protocols in a production network, such as Virtual Local Area Networks (VLANs), 802.1q, and port-channels.

Desired Qualifications:

Network engineering and design experience specific to CAN/LAN. Experience should include application of industry standards, developing configurations, and integration of solutions into production environments.

Network engineering and design experience with MPLS WANs, network management tools, and firewalls.

Expert knowledge of routing and switching protocols and the ability to demonstrate knowledge through briefings and documentation. Extensive BGP experience a plus.

Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) or equivalent knowledge.

Initiative and disciplined to work unsupervised as part of a network engineering team. Experience establishing processes, developing documents, and organizing repositories a plus.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.

The Opportunity

This position is a field-based position based in Chicago, IL in the Cardiac Rhythm Management division. As a global leader in Cardiac Rhythm Technologies, we focus on innovative technologies that can improve the way doctors treat people with heart arrhythmias or irregular heartbeats.

What You’ll Work On

Under general direction, the CRM Product Support Specialist provides comprehensive engineering, sales, educational, and technical support. This role responds to field inquiries from physicians, healthcare professionals, patients, and field sales staff regarding CRM (Cardiac Rhythm Management) products.

Key Responsibilities:

Clinical Interface: Acts as a clinical interface between the medical community and the business.

Relationship Building: Demonstrates the ability to build and sustain credible business relationships with customers and share product expertise accordingly.

This seasoned consultant should have a track record of strong leadership, professional business acumen, polished oral and written communication, documentation and presentation skills. Also, he/she should be well-rounded and adept at leading consultative engagements, assessing network environments, and architecting designs for data center and network solutions, and creating meaningful, cohesive deliverables. 

Key Roles and Responsibilities: 

An AT&T Lead Consultant is expected to become accustomed to and follow an established, repeatable methodology, leverage appropriate templates, actively participate in or facilitate status meetings, report status, and attend other required project meetings, including lessons learned meetings, complete all administration, reports and mandatory compliance training on time and as directed. The Sr. Consultant will also stay abreast of the latest marketing trends or chief concerns in their profession and participate in National Practice operations, process improvement and training calls, and take accountability for their own professional development and career growth, as well as sharing knowledge with others.

Collaborate, confer and provides consulting services and manages project activities from client identification through final invoicing. 

Works on billable consulting service projects. 

Demonstrates broad product knowledge with the customer within a specific discipline. 

Works independently on highly complex projects , or may work in a team as assigned by the project leader. 

Technical responsibilities will include problem identification, system architecture definition, hardware/software specification and/or design, implementation, testing, client training, and deployment. 

Leads all technical aspects of delivery, customer satisfaction, and accurate timekeeping for billing purposes, on projects where the Consultant is the only technical resource or lead technical resource. 

Demonstrates expert knowledge of principles, theories and concepts in applicable discipline, plus high level of working knowledge in other related fields. May assist less experienced peers when needed. 

Work is performed under minimal direction.

As a member of a team of advanced infrastructure consultants and lead consultants, you will use your in-depth knowledge of networking to design and implement solutions for our clients. 

Responsible for consulting project activities from client identification through final invoicing.

Fulfills billable consulting service projects.

Acts as the subject matter expert within a specific discipline.

Typically leads an engagement team, consisting of other Consultants and/or Sr. Consultant, or may be the sole consulting resource on a project.

Technical responsibilities include problem identification, system architecture definition, hardware/software specification and/or design, implementation, testing, client training, and deployment.

Typically viewed as a mentor or coach.

Creates recommendation and implements new methods, techniques and /or procedures.

QUALIFICATIONS:

At AT&T Consulting, you will be working with the best in the industry. Here is how the candidate will contribute:

10+ years of experience in the planning, design and implementation of complex networks as part of a large enterprise network team, or within the professional services or network integration environments.

Planning, design and integration of secure network technology.

A positive, energetic attitude and a serious desire to have an impact on your company and the industry.

Accomplished at developing Visio designs/diagrams and documenting professional, cohesive deliverables. Sample deliverables will be requested as evidence of documentation skills.

Verifiable strong ethics, trustworthiness, accountability and reliability in being resourceful and self-directed while possessing both a positive leadership and collaborative teamwork style.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Thorough understanding of internetworking technologies and how technologies are deployed in complex, global networks. IPv4 and IPv6 experience.

WAN and preferably iWAN Expertise – Transport and Access Planning, Design and Deployment Experience

Experience in analysis and selection of transport and access technologies including; MPLS, Private Line, Hybrid WAN, Internet Complex, Ethernet, Internet VPN, DWDM, and wireless.

MPLS Integration including MPLS equipment & transport selection, QoS, MPLS IP Routing and MPLS migration planning/transition

LAN Expertise – Planning, Design and Deployment Experience

Experience in equipment selection, sizing and detailed engineered design

Data center expertise including core, distribution and segmentation

Wireless equipment selection, sizing and detailed engineered design

Layer 2 vs Layer 3 segmentation

Virtualization using path segmentation (GRE, VRF-Lite, L3VPN’s, L2VPN’s)

IP Routing – Planning, Design & Deployment Experience

IP Routing Protocols – OSPF, BGP, M-BGP, EIGRP capabilities and corresponding configurations.

IP Addressing – NAT, DNS/DHCP, Address Summarization as it impacts IP addressing and IP routing.

Data Center Expertise – DC Core Network Planning, Design and Deployment Experience

Experience in analysis, design, engineering and deployment of DC core networks built on legacy architectures and fabric enabled architectures. 

Experience with Load Balancing, DNS/DHCP, NAT, WANx and Proxies

Experience with separation and segmentation technologies (VLAN, VRF)

Experience with network virtualization technologies

Experience with Cisco ACI SDN technologies

Network Equipment – Strong knowledge of features, functionality and configurations for Cisco Systems, Nortel, Juniper, Extreme Networks, etc.

Firewall design, configuration, network segmentation and implementation experience, such as Cisco ASA, CheckPoint, Fortinet, etc.

Understanding of load-balancing, F5 experience is a plus.

Knowledge and experience with SDN, Juniper, Velocloud, VMware/Virtualization, and/or IoT is also a significant plus.

REQUIRED SKILLS

Bachelor’s degree

Industry Certifications CCIE, or proven equivalent experience with CCNA, CCNP or CISSP

Very strong leadership, documentation, project management skills.

Ability to lead, coordinate complex networking engagements for very large environments in a nebulous or unfamiliar setting.

Ability to travel for engagement requirements.

職務目的（Job Purpose）

保険事業において、アンダーライティングは中核かつ不可欠な要素です。アンダーライターによる意思決定は、保険会社の損益に直接影響を及ぼします。

日本において、経営保険商品は市場が急速に成長しているものの、まだ成熟段階にある商品です。アンダーライターには、実際のアンダーライティングだけでなく、販売促進や研修など、個々の貢献が期待されています。

事業品質を維持し、革新的な商品を市場に提供し、収益性の高い成長を実現するために、こうした業務に注力できる適切な人材を求めています。

職責（Job Responsibilities）

ファイナンシャルラインのアンダーライターとして、法人顧客向けの保険契約条件の決定を行います。

経営保険の主要商品は、D&O、専門職賠償責任保険、サイバー保険、雇用慣行賠償責任保険、クライム保険などです。候補者はこれらの商品を幅広く扱うだけでなく、特定の事業分野をリードすることも期待されます。

アンダーライターとして、顧客、ブローカー、代理店と交渉を行います。

アンダーライティングだけでなく、マーケティング活動や商品開発も業務に含まれます。

アンダーライターグループを管理し、専門知識を提供することでサポートする責任を負う場合があります。

主要な関係先（Key Relationships）

Data Privacy, Security & Encryption 

- Defining/Implement Service Now data classification, data retention & data discovery strategy in alignment with Ameriprise data management policies standards

- Implement data encryption strategy at rest, in transit & encryption key management

Secure Integrations & Automation

Leadership & Collaboration

-Collaborate with cybersecurity, data, and infrastructure teams to ensure platform alignment with enterprise architecture.

-Lead technical design reviews, platform governance, and roadmap planning for platform security aspects

- ServiceNow Security: Deep understanding of ServiceNow Security design Components (ACLs , RBAC, etc.) and platform security best practices.

 Certifications

- Knowledge of Service Now Data fundamental (CMDB and CSDM)

Success in this role requires strong federal sales experience, knowledge of federal contracting and sales methodologies, the ability to manage complex technology solutions, and a proven record of exceeding sales targets through collaboration with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders.

Job Duties/Responsibilities:

Lead, coach, and develop a high‑performing sales team & culture, providing ongoing guidance, feedback, training and performance optimization.

Implement regular account reviews, sales plan coaching sessions and performance reviews to foster a high-performance sales culture.

Develop and execute account and sales strategies to drive new revenue, expand existing accounts, and increase market share.

Build and maintain key strategic and trusted relationships with executive-level customers; executive‑level customers; lead negotiations and resolve complex customer issues.

Manage a portfolio of complex accounts, ensuring profitable growth and long‑term customer success.

Drive and manage the full sales lifecycle across products and solutions, including Wireline and Wireless.

Build, qualify, and manage a robust sales pipeline in partnership with internal partner organizations. Ensure regular pipeline funnel reviews with all stakeholders.

Responsible for managing team’s overall Salesforce hygiene for designated customer pipeline on a weekly basis as well as monthly financial reporting with focus on net new sales and revenue forecasting.

Allocate and manage sales territories to ensure optimal coverage and opportunity capture.

Prepare business cases and proposals; demonstrate strong understanding of financial impacts and commitments.

Partner cross‑functionally and across markets to ensure coordinated, enterprise‑wide account management.

Apply consultative and strategic selling practices to understand customer needs and deliver mission‑aligned solutions.

Stay current on products, services, and market trends to effectively position solutions and guide the sales team.

Serve as escalation point for customer issues and ensure timely, effective resolution.

Washington, DC area–based position with required office presence in Chantilly, VA.

Strong knowledge of DHS customer.

Proficiency in AT&T solution portfolio and/or general technology background.

Demonstrated success managing large enterprise Federal accounts.

Proven sales leader with advanced knowledge of sales principles, methodologies, products, and services.

Demonstrated ability to independently manage large, complex sales opportunities with minimal supervision and broad strategic direction.

Experience owning and delivering against higher‑than‑average sales quotas and/or complex territories.

Strong executive communication (written / verbal including PowerPoint presentations), analytical, and problem‑solving skills; ability to leverage data and experience to drive results.

Deep understanding of customer mission requirements and alignment to AT&T and partner solutions.

Ability to coach, train, and mentor sales professionals, driving skill development and performance improvement.

Recognized subject matter expert in technical and solution‑based selling, including:

Advising customers on solution suitability based on technical and mission needs

Developing proposals, presentations, bids, pricing, and strategic sales plans

Collaborating with internal and external partners (e.g., engineering, design, solution teams) to develop integrated solutions

Researching customer industries and environments to identify new growth opportunities

Masters / Bachelor’s degree (BS/BA) or 10+ years of related sales experience.

Support data-driven decision-making by gathering and analyzing relevant data for AI initiatives.

Passion for AI:
Genuine interest in AI technologies, trends, and practical applications.

Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Business Analytics, Marketing, or a related field.

Creative & Analytical Thinking:
Innovative mindset with the ability to think outside the box and solve complex problems.

Strong Communication:

Self-Starter & Team Player:
Proactive attitude with the ability to work autonomously and take full ownership of projects while collaborating effectively with others.

Director, Strategic Programs & Content Systems 

(AI-Enabled Publishing & Platform Transformation) 

About the Role 

We’re building the next-generation clinical intelligence platform for prescribers — one that combines rigorous drug data, real-time evidence updates, and AI-powered synthesis into a seamless, trustworthy experience. 

We are seeking a senior leader to transform how our clinical content is created, structured, governed, and delivered. This role sits at the intersection of editorial strategy, AI workflow design, program management, and platform operations. 

You will modernize our existing news and drug information systems, implement scalable AI-enabled workflows, and lay the operational foundation for a full-fledged digital newsroom. This is a builder role for someone energized by systems transformation, not incremental editing. 

This position may begin as a contractor engagement with a pathway to full-time leadership. 

 

What You’ll Lead 

1. Transform the Clinical Newsfeed into a Modern Publishing Engine 

We currently publish 10+ news items per weekday, largely AI-assisted summaries of new studies. The next phase requires moving from output volume to editorial intelligence and audience growth. 

You will: 

Redesign workflows to elevate quality, consistency, and journalistic rigor 

Introduce stronger headline strategy, embargo planning, and differentiated formats (polls, quizzes, expert columns) 

Establish audience-first prioritization and performance metrics 

Optimize newsletter, push, and social distribution 

Implement early SEO and discoverability foundations 

Define how human editors and AI collaborate at scale 

Long-term, you will help architect a structured, searchable content library that feeds AI models — enabling dynamic topic hubs (e.g., “statin side effects”) that surface: 

Individual study summaries 

Linked primary sources 

AI-assisted state-of-the-evidence overviews 

Human editorial synthesis 

 

2. Rebuild Drug Information Operations for the AI Era 

Our Drug Info and Drug Interactions team currently operates like expert librarians — ensuring precision and completeness across thousands of micro-updates. 

We’re ready to evolve this into a publication-oriented, metrics-driven model. 

You will: 

Redesign workflows from maintenance-based to impact-based 

Introduce per-page productivity metrics and output tracking 

Shift prioritization toward user and business value 

Establish clearer monograph dating and transparency standards 

Develop structured content architecture aligned with AI ingestion 

Modernize documentation, governance, and change management processes 

This is operational transformation at scale. 

 

3. Stand Up a Digital Newsroom for Prescribers 

We are building a trusted, data-aligned newsroom that integrates seamlessly with our clinical databases. 

The newsroom will include: 

Drug news and regulatory updates 

Guideline changes 

Evidence-based lifestyle insights 

Expert columns 

Data visualizations 

Interactive formats (polls, quizzes) 

You will: 

Help define newsroom org structure and operating model 

Collaborate with Product to implement a headless CMS (likely Sanity) 

Ensure content is structured as data, not static pages 

Align editorial output with database integrity and trust standards 

Develop hiring roadmap (targeting Q4 scale-up) 

Establish metrics for engagement, growth, and subscriber acquisition 

 

What Makes This Role Unique 

This is not a traditional editorial leadership role. 

It is: 

Systems design 

AI workflow implementation 

Content-as-data architecture 

Operational rigor at scale 

Audience growth experimentation 

Change management across teams 

You’ll operate similarly to an early-stage GoodRx Health environment — building structure, testing what works, and scaling what resonates. 

 

What You Bring 

10+ years in digital health, publishing, or clinical content operations 

Director-level experience building systems, not just managing output 

Strong program management foundation (PMP a plus) 

Experience implementing AI into content workflows 

Familiarity with headless CMS and content-as-data models 

Ability to move between strategic vision and tactical execution 

Experience scaling teams in startup or high-growth environments 

Comfort operating in ambiguity while setting structure 

Bonus: 

Healthcare, life sciences, or public health background 

Experience working with prescriber audiences 

Exposure to SEO and newsletter growth strategy 

 

Timeline & Structure 

Immediate focus: Newsfeed optimization and Drug Info operational redesign (urgent, beginning by April) 

Near-term: CMS implementation partnership with Product 

Q4: Newsroom hiring and scale-up 

Open to contractor-to-FTE pathway. 

 

Why This Matters 

Prescribers are overwhelmed with information but under-supported in synthesis. We believe the future lies in: 

Structured clinical intelligence 

AI + human editorial partnership 

Transparent evidence tracking 

Real-time, decision-shaping content 

This role will help define that future.

Role summary:
 

Help restore critical services with speed, clarity, and coordination. The Incident Manager is responsible for leading incident response activities, minimizing business impact, and helping ensure service restoration happens as quickly and effectively as possible while maintaining strong communication across stakeholders. This role is based in Bangalore - Whitefield, India and follows a hybrid work model. The role also supports analysis of incident trends, identification of workarounds and resolution opportunities, and coordination of follow-up actions that strengthen service reliability over time. This position reports to the Director of Service Management.

Team Summary:

As an Incident Manager in the Cloud Infrastructure Engineering organization, you will be part of the Service Management team, which is focused on restoring impacted services to an operational state quickly while managing risk and ongoing business impact. The team coordinates incident response efforts, keeps teams aligned on service restoration priorities, and ensures that resolution remains the immediate focus until business impact has been addressed.

This role also contributes to the broader effectiveness of service management by reviewing historical incident data, identifying patterns, and helping define practical actions that can reduce recurrence or improve response readiness. The Incident Manager facilitates discussions across technical and business stakeholders to review incident trends, evaluate response effectiveness, and communicate findings, risks, and recommendations to senior management.

Success in this role requires a solid understanding of enterprise infrastructure and service dependencies, along with the ability to guide structured discussions during time-sensitive situations. Because incidents can occur at any time, this role requires schedule flexibility, including availability across nights, weekends, and holidays, based on business need.

Essential Job Responsibilities:

Lead incident response coordination to restore impacted services as quickly as possible while maintaining focus on business impact and service quality. 

Manage major incident communications across technical teams, operational stakeholders, and leadership to ensure timely, accurate, and consistent updates. 

Assess incidents for impact, urgency, and priority using established incident management practices and ITIL-aligned processes. 

Facilitate structured incident bridges and stakeholder discussions to support decision-making, escalation management, and resolution progress. 

Analyze incident records and historical trends to identify recurring issues, potential workarounds, and opportunities for service improvement. 

Partner with resolver teams, operations teams, and leadership to ensure incident records, actions, and outcomes are documented with a high level of quality. 

Drive follow-through on post-incident actions by coordinating with Problem Management and other stakeholders on remediation and prevention planning.

Additional Job Responsibilities:
 

Prepare operational summaries, dashboards, and trend reports for leadership review. 

Support continuous improvement initiatives for incident handling, escalation paths, and response procedures. 

Review standard operating procedures with resolver groups to help improve incident readiness and response consistency. 

Contribute to service management discussions related to process maturity, reporting quality, and operational effectiveness. 

Coordinate with cross-functional teams during release-related or change-related incidents when additional alignment is required. 

Assist in identifying gaps in monitoring, alerting, documentation, or communication workflows that may affect incident response. 

Participate in scheduled on-call or flexible coverage expectations aligned to incident management needs.

Expected Education & Experience:

8+ years of experience in Incident Management, Service Management, IT Operations, Site Reliability, Infrastructure Operations, or a related technology function. 

Working knowledge of Incident Management, Problem Management, and ITIL practices. 

Experience coordinating activities across multiple stakeholders in a structured and time-sensitive environment. 

Ability to communicate clearly in verbal and written formats with technical and non-technical audiences. 

Familiarity with documenting incidents, actions, decisions, and outcomes in ticketing or workflow management systems. 

Understanding of enterprise infrastructure, application dependencies, and service restoration concepts. 

Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience

Manage and develop team members by setting clear expectations, supporting prioritization, and providing ongoing coaching and feedback.

Communicate accounting matters clearly to varied audiences, tailoring detail and context to business needs.

Prepare ad hoc analyses and management reporting as needed.

Position Summary:

The Pricing Strategy Manager at athenahealth is a key contributor to the company’s pricing initiatives, focusing on leveraging technology and AI capabilities to drive actionable, data-driven insights. This role is based in Boston, MA, with a hybrid setup that includes in-person collaboration and remote work within the US. The individual will report directly to the Pricing Strategy Director and will play a vital part in shaping our pricing strategies through data analysis, reporting, and cross-functional collaboration with the company’s analytics and IT teams. 

About the Team:

The Pricing Strategy team operates with a three-pronged charter, aimed at leveraging data-driven insights to support strategic decision-making and foster long-term customer relationships:

Implement price uplifts across the existing customer base to ensure sustainable revenue growth.

Develop and execute innovative pricing strategies aimed at increasing customer retention and minimizing attrition.

Build and refine reporting and analytics frameworks that inform current and future pricing initiatives.

Essential Job Responsibilities:

Partner with the company analytics and IT teams to co-develop, test, and iterate upon AI & BI-enabled tools — actively contributing to prompt design, use case definition, and validation to ensure tools surface actionable pricing insights. 

Leverage AI-assisted analysis tools to evaluate go-to-market pricing and packaging trends at scale, identifying opportunities and recommending optimal price and package configurations for specific prospect types.

Design and deliver pricing recommendations and playbooks that sellers can apply to specific customer types and deal contexts. 

Prepare and present reports on pricing performance, trends, and insights to stakeholders — utilizing automated reporting and AI summarization tools to efficiently surface the "why" behind results and translate findings into clear improvement actions for the ELT & Corporate Sponsors. 

Partner with Director Pricing Strategy to create and govern the Pricing KPI package for ELT reporting, ensuring accuracy, clarity, and actionable insights. 

Manage cross-functional projects with Sales, Product, Finance, and Data Engineering to operationalize pricing changes — using AI and other tools to accelerate analysis, scenario modeling, and tracking setup. 

Communicate complex analyses and recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders, translating technical findings into business actions. 

Additional Job Responsibilities:

Support ad-hoc win/loss analyses and competitive pricing benchmarking as requested by leadership.

Collaborate on experiments and A/B tests to validate the impact of pricing changes.

Contribute to development of pricing tools and decision-support systems used by sellers.

Participate in reviews of pricing strategies and provide input on future state priorities.

Assist in documenting pricing policies, model assumptions, and governance processes.

Expected Education & Experience:

4–7 years of relevant experience in pricing analytics, revenue management, commercial analytics, or a related field.

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Statistics, Data Science, or a related discipline (or equivalent experience).

Strong Excel skills, including advanced functions and modeling.

Power BI or Tableau experience for dashboarding and executive reporting.

Experience with Python and/or R highly desired for analysis, modeling, and reproducible workflows.

Practical experience applying AI/ML techniques to analytics, forecasting, or model-driven pricing is highly desired.

Demonstrated experience collaborating with sales, finance, product, and engineering stakeholders to drive commercial outcomes.

Managing a high volume of tasks and maintaining priorities.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Health Information team within our Patient Experience division. The Health Information & Payments Zone is responsible for empowering patients in the evolving healthcare ecosystem by helping them access and understand their health information, manage their personal information, and understand and manage their financial responsibilities. This position is based in Austin, TX.

The Opportunity:
We are looking for a seasoned Senior Product Manager to help guide product discovery, development, and delivery in a nimble, AI-assisted fashion.

But enough about us; let’s talk about you. You are passionate about problem-solving and always take a consumer-centric approach. You know how to energize cross-functional teams around a problem and use data to identify and prioritize solutions. You push and strive toward the best long-term solution while executing against that plan day-to-day. You are passionate about using AI tools to help you work smarter and faster to achieve your and the team’s goals.

Job Responsibilities 

Drive ongoing backlog allocations and prioritization of patient jobs to be done to solve within area of responsibility 

Create and update a feature roadmap for your area of responsibility that drives toward business and experiential outcomes

Understand the market opportunity via user needs, market forces, and applicable business models; with regards to what would best serve our patients and clients today as well as in the future 

Identify and track metrics and success criteria to create transparency and visibility to program success and opportunities for improvement; requesting analyses to inform backlog 

Partner with Product Management leaders to be the voice of product decisions within the organization 

Serve as Product Owner for scrum team(s) covering assigned product area, partnering with UX and Engineering to plan work and ensure project execution tracks to that plan

Partner with Product Management leaders to drive portfolio and product strategy 

Engage with Sales, Product Marketing, and other internal partner teams as needed to determine best ways to communicate product to customers; and to assist Product Management leadership with service descriptions

About epocrates 

epocrates is a leading medical reference and point-of-care app trusted by healthcare professionals across the USA for over 25 years. As part of athenahealth, the epocrates R&D group is dedicated to delivering cohesive, end-to-end clinical experiences that provide fast, trusted, and clear clinical intelligence. Guided by the epocrates vision to be the trusted partner providing actionable insights and expert guidance for evolving healthcare needs, we simplify complex information to help clinicians make confident decisions wherever they are in their careers. 

We are seeking a UX Designer to join the epocrates UX design team to shape innovative experiences that clinicians rely on daily, enabling them to provide better patient care through smarter, streamlined interactions. 

Role and responsibilities 

As a UX Designer, you will split your focus between two dynamic product zones. On the Monetization zone, you will contribute to crafting engaging user experiences by designing tailored messaging strategies, optimizing the placement of commercial advertising, and managing the user experience for Membership. This includes creating effective upsell messaging and designing seamless subscription account management flows. Your work will directly influence how advertising and membership features integrate smoothly into our platforms while maintaining a positive and cohesive user experience. 

On the Foundations zone, you will support the design system team. You will help design, maintain, and evolve reusable design system components that promote consistency, efficiency, and scalability across the company’s products. 

Throughout both roles, you will partner with product managers, engineers, and other stakeholders to translate user needs and business goals into intuitive, high-quality design solutions. This role provides an opportunity to grow your expertise in both customer-facing and internal user experiences, while contributing to the broader design culture within the organization. 

 

Role location: 

Remote 

 

Responsibilities may include, but are not limited to: 

75% - Design execution (primary) 

Identify and frame user-centered problems clearly. 

Develop low- to high-fidelity designs and prototypes to communicate ideas. 

Collaborate on design and upkeep of our multi-platform design system in Figma. 

Work with product, engineering, and stakeholders throughout the software development lifecycle to ensure designs meet user needs and design intent. 

Partner with the UX team to uphold quality in workflows, interaction design, microcopy, and accessibility. 

Create diagrams, journey maps, and UX process artifacts to guide effective solutions. 

Collaborate with UX research to discover opportunities and refine designs through testing. 

Embrace a “fail fast, learn faster” mindset to encourage experimentation. 

Own the design of various cross-platform features. 

 

25% - Design strategy and planning 

Collaborate with UX leadership to define project scope and success criteria. 

Partner with product and engineering leads to guide strategic direction for key features. 

Participate in product backlog prioritization and planning activities. 

Participate in foundational user research to understand user workflows, goals, and needs. 

Use qualitative and quantitative data in ideation sessions to inform design decisions. 

Advocate for user experiences, including commercial advertising partner content. 

Support product frameworks like the Opportunity Solution Trees

​

Required Qualifications 

Bachelor's or master's degree in design, HCI, or related field. 

Minimum 3 years of experience in UX or Product Design (agency or in-house). 

Expert-level skills in Figma for design and prototyping. 

Proficient in designing multiple platforms including Responsive Web and native iOS/Android apps. 

Strong collaborator, experienced working closely with cross-functional teams (e.g., product, engineering, marketing) and stakeholders or clients. 

Excellent communication and presentation skills, capable of influencing diverse stakeholders. 

Solid understanding of accessibility standards and UX best practices. 

Ability to advocate effectively for user-centered design principles. 

Skilled in UX ideation and design methodologies. 

Portfolio showcasing strong visual design, aesthetic sensibility, and successful UX/UI projects across diverse teams. 

​

Desired Qualifications 

Experience with digital advertising design. 

Experience in healthcare, health tech, or digital publishing. 

Experience creating AI-powered design solutions. 

Hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g., Figma Make, Windsurf, ChatGPT) for ideation, prototyping, and code generation.

Senior Manager of Influencer Relations

We are looking for a Senior Manager of Influencer Relations to join the Marketing team at athenahealth. In this role, the Senior Manager of Influencer Relations will lead the evolution of our Analyst Relations function at athenahealth into a modern, strategic industry influencer relations program. This role is designed for a healthcare-savvy communicator with experience managing relationships with HIT associations and analyst firms, orchestrating high-impact influencer events, and managing C-Suite executive briefings. This role reports into the vice president of Ecosystem Marketing 

 

In addition to overseeing key analyst firm relationships, like KLAS and Gartner, the Senior Manager of Influencer Relations will lead program development and execution for Consultant Day, Private Equity Day, and Analyst Day. These hosted, in-person events aim to attract top-tier national and vertical-specific healthcare IT firms to discuss the collective needs of shared customers and identify opportunities for deeper collaboration. These events are a critical part of our strategy to build trusted relationships, uncover growth insights, and align on forward-looking healthcare technology priorities. 

 

The ideal candidate will bring a mix of healthcare technology domain knowledge, project leadership skills, and relationship-building acumen to support strategic reputation building. The Senior Manager of Influencer Relations will partner closely with Customer Advocacy, Segment Marketing, and Integrated Communications to ensure analyst coverage and association relationships remain strong, while simultaneously expanding our reach and credibility through new influencer engagement programs. 

Job Responsibilities

Act as a relationship manager to key associations, influencers, consultants, and investors in our ecosystem—building long-term trust and engagement. 

Cultivate and manage relationships with key healthcare industry associations (e.g., AMA, BGH) to expand athenahealth’s industry influence, identify partnership opportunities, and support executive thought leadership initiatives. 

Serve as the primary program lead for all KLAS-related activity—owning our KLAS performance roadmap and quarterly engagement strategy, maintaining visibility into upcoming KLAS reports, and coordinating internal readiness plans. 

Establish a scalable process to track analyst survey activity and performance; identify trends and communicate insights back to executive leaders to improve customer experience scores and perceptions.

You’ll join a five-person analytics team spanning the US and India. In this Senior Manager position, you will be the primary steward of our HR data model and reporting products. Maintain and own the HR data model: add validated metrics, ensure documentation, and represent the HR data model in enterprise data initiatives.

Define and execute data model strategy, including collaboration with internal teams or external vendors.

Partner with the Data Management Office and data engineering teams to align Snowflake architecture, data lineage, access controls, and transformation patterns.

Demonstrate strong appetite and working understanding of data engineering principles—how data is ingested, transformed, and made production-ready—and translate those considerations into product requirements.

Develop and manage the reporting and visualization roadmap across Workday, Power BI, and other tools; inventory existing reports and prioritize build vs. sunset decisions.

Audit and consolidate existing reports and dashboards; define reporting tiers (executive, CPOD, self-service, operational) and rationalize overlaps.

Collaborate with analytics, HR Product Group, and IT partners to define integration requirements, support analytics leads in solving stakeholder needs, and ensure deliverables meet expectations.

Serve as the subject matter expert for the data dictionary and DMO-related documentation.

Support ad hoc analytics product communications, stakeholder updates, and change management for reporting launches.

Drive process improvements to reduce manual reporting effort and increase automation.

Participate in vendor evaluations, proof-of-concepts, and contract discussions as needed.

Mentor and coach team members on data model usage, documentation standards, product thinking, and visualization design.

Represent People Analytics in cross-functional working groups that impact workforce data and reporting.

Assist in defining success metrics and adoption KPIs for reporting products and self-service capabilities.

8–14 years of relevant experience in analytics product management, data management, people analytics, or related areas.

Demonstrated experience with analytics and visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) and reporting platforms (Workday reporting preferred).

Proficiency with data infrastructure concepts and technologies (e.g., Snowflake, SQL, ETL pipelines, data modeling).

Working knowledge of data engineering principles, including ingestion patterns, transformation logic, scheduling, and productionization of pipelines.

Experience defining data dictionaries, governance practices, and working with a Data Management Office or equivalent.

Proven ability to build and manage product roadmaps, prioritize backlogs, and lead cross-functional delivery.

Strong stakeholder management and collaboration experience with IT, data engineering, HR systems, and business partners.

Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Statistics, HR Analytics); advanced degree preferred but not required.

Role summary:

Help keep athenahealth’s platform reliable and scalable by designing and delivering technical operations capabilities that improve resilience, speed, and operational efficiency. This is a Hybrid role based in Bangalore – Whitefield, India, focused on cloud infrastructure operations, automation, and platform migration work across AWS and Kubernetes environments, with strong cross-functional coordination to enable safe and frequent product releases. This role will report to the Director Engineering – Tech Ops.

Team summary:

CE SRE ensures the reliable operation of the platform hosted in a hybrid cloud environment. We partner closely with product teams to scale the platform effectively and enable faster, more efficient product feature releases. InfraOps is a sub-team within CE, focused on operating and scaling the hybrid cloud infrastructure. We are currently undergoing a large-scale migration from a self-managed AWS/Kubernetes/container-based environment to a centrally managed platform. At the same time, we continue to provide 24x7 enterprise-grade operational and user support. To drive efficiency and resilience, we leverage AI-assisted automation, Terraform Enterprise (TFE) for Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and advanced monitoring and alerting capabilities to enhance productivity and operational excellence. In this environment, the team balances near-term operational needs with long-term platform modernization. Work includes improving deployment safety through CI/CD practices, strengthening observability to reduce time-to-detect and time-to-recover, and building repeatable infrastructure patterns that support consistency across services. The team collaborates across engineering, security, and product stakeholders to ensure changes are delivered with appropriate controls, clear communication, and measurable reliability outcomes.

Essential Job Responsibilities:

· Design and implement scalable infrastructure and operational patterns across AWS, Kubernetes, and hybrid cloud environments to improve platform reliability and performance.

· Develop automation and tooling in Python to reduce manual operational work and improve consistency across common workflows.

· Lead infrastructure-as-code practices using Terraform and Terraform Enterprise (TFE), including module standards, change controls, and reusable patterns.

· Drive CI/CD improvements that increase deployment safety, reduce lead time for changes, and support consistent release practices across teams.

· Partner with product and engineering teams to plan and execute platform migration work from self-managed environments to centrally managed platforms, managing dependencies and risks.

· Coordinate cross-functionally with stakeholders to align priorities, communicate operational readiness, and ensure smooth execution of complex initiatives.

· Strengthen operational excellence through improvements to monitoring, alerting, incident response practices, and post-incident corrective actions.

Additional Job Responsibilities:

· Contribute to technical strategy by identifying opportunities to improve resilience, cost efficiency, and operational scalability across the platform.

· Document operational standards, runbooks, and migration playbooks to support consistent execution and onboarding.

· Support evaluation and adoption of AI-assisted automation approaches that improve productivity and reduce repetitive work.

· Review designs and changes for operational readiness, including rollback planning, capacity considerations, and failure-mode analysis.

· Collaborate with security and compliance partners to ensure infrastructure changes align with required controls and policies.

· Facilitate knowledge sharing across teams on infrastructure patterns, CI/CD practices, and incident learnings.

· Assist with prioritization and planning by translating operational needs into scoped projects with clear milestones and measurable outcomes.

Expected Education & Experience (Required):

· 12–18 years of experience in technical operations, site reliability engineering, infrastructure engineering, or related roles supporting production systems.

· Demonstrated hands-on experience with coding, including Python, to build automation and operational tooling.

· Strong experience designing or operating AWS architecture in production environments.

· Very strong Linux Experience

· AWS/Kubernetes Enterprise grade Implementation and Management

· IaC-TFE, Harness or similar for CI/CD, Ansible , Redis as caching, Advanced Alerting and Monitoring such as DataDog, message handling such as Kafka

· Hands on Python scripting experience

· Strong experience of Generative AI Automation such as Windsurf, copilot Claude-Codex

· Proven experience with Kubernetes and container-based platforms, including reliability and scaling considerations.

· Experience with Terraform (including enterprise IaC practices such as module reuse, reviews, and controlled rollouts).

· Experience improving or operating CI/CD pipelines and release processes in collaboration with engineering teams.

· Demonstrated stakeholder management, cross-functional collaboration, and project management experience for complex, multi-team initiatives.

· Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

Good to Have

· Understanding of object relation DataBase such as Postgres

· Loging, Monitoring & Metrics

· Dashboard

Work split

· Hands on work, coding, Design and implementation a solution, Enterprise grade operational support, might include On-Call on rotational basis

· Stakeholders and Project Management

· Global Team mentorship and management as SPOC for tech and ops lead

Position Summary:

The Product Engagement Liaison builds strong relationships with Product team members to understand roadmaps and ongoing initiatives, surfacing actionable insights that inform product development decisions. They analyze and synthesize customer feedback for their product areas and contribute to the creation and curation of insight artifacts that align the business around key customer and prospect priorities.

Additionally, they may coordinate cross-organizational initiatives that impact customers. Success in this role requires strong athenaOne product knowledge, excellent relationship-building and influencing skills, and proficiency in data analysis.

About the Team: 

The Product Engagement team within Voice of Customer serves as a critical bridge between our Commercial and Product organizations by tracking, advocating for, and closing the loop on customer needs, including customers, prospects, and internal teams. Product Liaisons develop and maintain deep expertise in their assigned product areas, including strategic objectives, roadmaps, and organizational structures, while mastering the customer feedback relevant to their domains.

The Voice of the Customer team at athenahealth is creating a culture where customers are at the core of everything athenahealth does. We enable the customer voice by collecting, analyzing and sharing customer feedback to drive awareness and action organizationally in partnership with our product and service teams. 

Responsibilities: 

70% - Platform & Interoperability Product Advocacy and Release Planning

Analyze and synthesize customer feedback to identify key pain points and trends for Platform & Interoperability customers and prospects.

Manage and maintain feedback data sources with accurate tagging and categorization to enable effective reporting and trend analysis.

Own and update a taxonomy for Platform & Interoperability survey data using the Natural Language Processing technology.

Take ownership in creating artifacts, processes, and strategic initiatives that support customer experience goals.

Develop a deep understanding of customer organizations and end-user workflows, showing empathy for their challenges and perceptions of Platform & Interoperability value.

Support Customer Sentiment reports by analyzing data and crafting clear, compelling narratives.

Build strong relationships with product stakeholders, service and operations teams, and partners, collaborating closely with other Voice of Customer team members.

Stay updated on corporate strategy, product roadmaps, and initiatives related to Platform & Interoperability, partnering with Product Market Strategy and Marketing to understand market trends.

Collaborate closely with key cross-functional teams to ensure customer insights inform product and service decisions.

15% - Cross-Functional Coordination

Represent the Platform & Interoperability product within the Commercial organization, gathering insights from Platform Services, Partner Success, Sales, and other customer-facing teams.

Work with internal teams to prioritize projects and goals, offering strategic advice and managing trade-offs when necessary.

Recommend and promote solutions that improve customer experiences.

Collaborate with Voice of the Customer team members to create and share internal resources, such as documentation on the CS Knowledge Portal and training for customer-facing teams.

Support cross-functional efforts by managing feedback channels, guiding customer communication strategies, and aligning messaging between CS and R&D.

15% - VoC Strategy and Process Improvement

Work with VoC colleagues to improve methods for collecting and reporting customer feedback from multiple sources.

Share VoC program results with key internal stakeholders and promote adoption of related processes.

Build deep expertise in the customer lifecycle and help define the roles of Customer Success and VoC in business processes.

Advocate for the VoC and Customer Success mission, promoting transparency, accountability, and teamwork.

Education, Experience, & Skills Required: 

Bachelor’s degree or 3–5 years of experience in customer or stakeholder relationship management.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Excellent organizational skills with attention to detail, good time management, and dependable follow-through.

Experience or strong interest in data analysis and manipulation, especially using Microsoft Excel.

Proven ability or interest in explaining complex product information and turning technical details into clear, actionable insights for external stakeholders.

Experience creating various content types, such as data sheets, promotional materials, and internal or external communications.

Skilled at managing multiple stakeholders with different needs and perspectives.

Experience working with cross-functional teams to achieve shared goals.

Adaptable and resilient in fast-paced, changing environments.

Experience with SQL is a plus.

Experience with Qualtrics XM Discover is a plus.

The Business System Analyst- Salesforce CPQ role is a crucial contributor in delivering and supporting business initiatives. The CPQ Business System Analyst’s main focus is the configuration of Salesforce CPQ. They collaborate closely with athenahealth business process owners, athenaIT Product and Project Managers, other Business Systems Analysts, and Development team members. As a member of the athenaIT team, their primary focus is on processes and technologies that support our business partners. They actively participate in the support and expansion of our technologies, continuous improvement, and growth, stability, and security of our systems.

The successful candidate for this role will be an experienced Salesforce CPQ Administrator who has a keen attention to detail. They will have a proven track record of transforming business requirements into system solutions that drive our business forward and provide value to all employees of athenahealth. The following attributes are key indicators of a successful candidate for this position:

Responsibilities 

Partner with Key Stakeholders: Collaborate with stakeholders and product managers to analyze, understand, and enhance employee productivity and end-user effectiveness, with a strong focus on improving the overall customer experience.

Requirements Gathering: Gather, analyze, and document functional and technical requirements for new projects, enhancements to existing solutions, and production issues.

System Administration: Design, develop and maintain Salesforce CPQ system solutions involving complex product bundles, price rules, validation rules, approval rules, document templates, etc. in support of new requests and enhancements.

Business Acumen - Demonstrate strong business acumen and possess in-depth knowledge of the Salesforce CPQ domain.

Documentation: Create and maintain detailed documentation, including business requirements documents, functional specs, user manuals, and JIRA stories.

System Enhancements: Define and implement system enhancements that align with business goals, advising on best practices and recommending process improvements to ensure scalability and efficiency.

Solution Design: Work with technical teams to design solutions that meet business needs, including system specifications and workflows. Solutions consider both up and downstream impact. 

Testing Plans: Develop test cases and conduct unit and integration testing to ensure that systems meet specified requirements and function correctly.

Training Materials: Develop, deliver, and present end-user training materials to Salesforce users throughout the organization.

Issue Resolution: Research production system issues, resolve user problems, and escalate issues when necessary.

Application Configuration: Perform application configuration activities primarily in Salesforce and other supporting Force.com applications.

Stakeholder Communication: Act as a liaison between business stakeholders and IT, facilitating communications and ensuring alignment on project goals. 

Continuous Improvement – Stay updated on industry trends and best practices, recommending improvements to enhance business efficiency.

Behaviors & Abilities Required

Detail oriented and organized professional who thrives in a high volume, multi-tiered environment.

Proven track record of following through on commitments and owning the outcome. 

Ability to adapt in a fast-paced environment while maintaining best practices and producing quality solutions. 

Ability to assess situations or problems from multiple perspectives to understand the complete picture. 

Ability to identify and influence alternative methods of solving problems and build efficiencies while doing so. 

Ability to communicate effectively, both written and verbal, with both technical and non-technical people. 

Ability to work independently as well as part of a cross functional team with a variety of experience levels. 

Enthusiastic team player and ability to maintain sense of humor in stressful situations. 

Is comfortable interfacing with senior leadership in a variety of communication channels.

Typical Qualifications 

Salesforce Certifications:

Salesforce Administrator certification required.

Minimum 2 years Salesforce CPQ experience required, Salesforce CPQ Specialist certification preferred.

Business Analysis Experience: 2-4 years of work experience as a business analyst, or related role.

System Administration Skills: Proficiency in Salesforce CPQ system administration, including user management, configuration, and maintenance of Salesforce environments, as well as prior experience working with related systems. Experience with Conga a plus but not required.

Familiarity with Tools: Knowledge of tools including JIRA, Confluence, and SOQL. Experience in creating and executing unit, integration, and user acceptance test plans.

Communication Skills: Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with team members and business stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

Problem-Solving Skills: Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and investigative skills.

Project Management Experience: Experience working in a mix of agile and waterfall project management methodologies is preferred.

Business Operations Experience (Optional): Familiarity with business operations processes and practices is a plus.

Prior Healthcare Experience (Optional): Experience in the healthcare industry is also considered beneficial.

Role Summary: 

Join athenahealth as a Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) Analyst and play a key role in shaping financial insight and operational decision-making. This position is based in Chennai, India and is offered as a hybrid role. Then FP&A Analyst will support expense management, monthly close activities, vendor planning, and financial performance reporting, and will report to the Financial Planning and Analysis Manager.

Team Summary: 

Embedded in the FP&A team, this role focuses on supporting expense management, monthly close activities, vendor planning, and financial performance reporting. The Analyst partners with managers, business stakeholders, and peers to prepare clear financial presentations, deliver actionable analyses, and ensure timely, accurate reporting. Responsibilities include consolidating and analyzing financial data, maintaining budgets and forecasts, identifying variance drivers, and recommending opportunities to optimize spend and improve financial performance. The role requires cross-functional collaboration with accounting, procurement, and business unit stakeholders to translate financial results into practical next steps and to support business planning cycles.
 

Essential Job Responsibilities:

Develop and maintain monthly and quarterly financial reports and dashboards that summarize expense performance and key metrics.

Analyze variances between actuals, budgets, and forecasts; identify drivers and communicate insights and recommendations to stakeholders.

Manage and execute parts of the monthly close process related to expense accounts and vendor activity.

Prepare and present financial analyses and executive-ready materials for leadership reviews and planning sessions.

Build and maintain financial models to support budgeting, forecasting, and scenario analysis.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams (procurement, accounting, business units) to support vendor planning and expense optimization initiatives.

Support ad hoc financial requests and special projects that enhance reporting, controls, and processes.

Additional Job Responsibilities:

Assist in process improvement initiatives to streamline reporting and reduce cycle time.

Document financial policies, procedures, and assumptions used in models and reports.

Participate in system and tool upgrades, including testing and validation of finance-related functionality.

Support monthly reconciliation and review of vendor-related financial transactions as needed.

Help prepare materials for external audits or internal reviews when requested.

Support periodic finance-driven business reviews and cross-functional planning workshops.

Expected Education & Experience:

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Commerce, or a related field.

3 to 5 years of relevant experience in Financial Planning & Analysis, corporate finance, or accounting.

Demonstrated experience with budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling, and variance analysis.

Proficiency in Excel and experience with financial reporting tools and ERP systems; familiarity with SQL, Power BI, Tableau, or similar analytics tools is advantageous.

Strong communication and presentation skills with experience preparing materials for leadership.

Ability to work effectively in a hybrid environment and collaborate across teams.

Able to work 2:30pm -11:30pm IST

Position Summary: 

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Quality Specialist with a strong background in US healthcare. The role is focused on helping advance our Integration Network Management team's skills and knowledge by providing exceptional customer service for our clients by supporting and executing training and quality initiatives that strengthen team performance and procedural excellence. The expectation from the role is that the individual will be responsible for coaching, processing documentation, providing feedback to team members and continuously helping to improve our service and growth. 

As a part of Training & Quality, you will be responsible for completing procedural quality reviews, providing feedback, delivering coaching to ensure consistent quality standards, effectively transferring knowledge to others, and leading ongoing skill development across teams and supporting existing/new hires to be successful in their current role. This role will involve planning, governance, and staying up to date with current workflows with in-depth knowledge in the existing process, overseeing the successful delivery of the team's objectives and goals. The individual will work closely with business function heads, managers, internal stakeholders, as well as external partners. 

The role requires a solid understanding of U.S. healthcare processes, attention to detail, and the ability to translate insights into actionable improvements. This role is ideal for someone who has strong hands-on experience in quality and process adherence and is ready to take on broader ownership across training enablement, coaching, and continuous improvement. 

This position plays an important role in maintaining operational stability while also supporting long-term capability building through training, documentation, and quality-driven insights. 

 
Essential Functions (Duties and Responsibilities): 

Quality & Process Excellence 

Perform procedural quality reviews and audits to ensure adherence to defined standards, derived workflows, and process requirements. 

Identify quality gaps, trends, and areas of improvement and communicate findings to managers and stakeholders. 

Provide clear, constructive, and actionable feedback to team members based on audit outcomes. 

Support continuous improvement initiatives by partnering with stakeholders to address recurring quality issues. 

Training & Enablement 

Support the delivery of training programs for new hires and existing team members, including refresher sessions and targeted interventions. 

Assist in maintaining and updating training materials, SOPs, playbooks, and knowledge management articles. 

Collaborate with Stakeholders and Managers to identify skill gaps and recommend focused coaching or training plans. 

Reporting & Stakeholder Collaboration 

Maintain quality and training trackers, dashboards, and reports to provide visibility into performance and progress. 

Use data from dashboards and audits to identify trends and recommend next steps. 

Escalate risks, blockers, or recurring issues proactively with suggested solutions. 

Documentation & Governance 

Ensure documentation is current, accurate, and aligned with process changes. 

Support governance activities related to quality reviews, training rollouts, and process updates. 

Contribute to standardization efforts across teams to ensure consistency and scalability. 

Education & Experience Required 

5-8 years of relevant experience in Quality, Training, Operations, or a related role (preferably within U.S. healthcare). 

Prior experience performing quality audits, coaching, or supporting training initiatives. 

Strong working knowledge of operational processes and service delivery models. 

Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, Teams). 

Experience working in a fast-paced, demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams and build positive relationships. 

Added Advantage 

Certification in quality tool or process improvement methodologies (Six Sigma, Lean similar) 

Exposure to learning management systems (LMS), quality dashboards, or reporting tools. 

Knowledge & Skills 

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a high capacity for attention to detail. 

Ability to interpret data and translate insights into actionable improvements. 

Strong and confident communication skills, both written and verbal, with a good ability to build relations with employees and leaders. 

Comprehensive presentation and documentation skills. 

Ability to provide unbiased, fact-based feedback. 

Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple responsibilities & business-oriented thinking 

A continuous improvement mindset and willingness to learn and grow into higher responsibilities.
