The Information Security group at athenahealth is looking for a security analyst to join our Cyber Security Operations Center (CSOC) team. This is a highly technical, hands-on role that acts as a top-tier (Tier 3) incident responder for cyber security incidents of all types, detection engineering, threat hunting, and serves as an incident coordinator during an on-call rotation for any incidents detected via automated alerting workflows or reported to the security team through several channels.

You must be someone who can debug complex problems and use methodical processes when troubleshooting a technical issue, including knowing when and how to work with team members, management, and other stakeholders in an effective and efficient manner. You must be an excellent communicator who can work with stakeholders to understand employee questions and potential concerns. You must provide strong stakeholder support and understand how and when to appropriately triage issues to completion and escalate potential issues appropriately. You are a tenacious and nimble learner who demonstrates design and engineering excellence. Being able to communicate security issues to employees in a non-technical manner is critical to success.

The Team:

The CSOC is a three-tiered structure responsible for ensuring the company's products and infrastructure are as secure as possible. The team works cross-functionally across the business with stakeholders to provide support, guidance, and technical implementations where appropriate, to include triage, containment, and remediation when applicable. Cross-functional teams in support of security threats or incidents include cyber threat intelligence, security engineering, public cloud security, risk management, and other security teams, but also dozens of technical teams in various environments.

Job Responsibilities: 

Understand that as the Tier 3 (highest level) engineer, you’re expected to handle potential incidents and act as the as a subject matter expert for all security-related tickets that come into the team's various queues (including triage, containment, and remediation when necessary).

Receive incident escalations from Tier 1 and 2 analysts, assisting with real-time advanced analysis, response, and reporting.

Mentor and assist in training Tier 1 and 2 analysts to aid in their skills development and analytical capabilities.

Proactively hunt for threats and enacting identification, containment, and eradication measures while supporting recovery efforts.

Serve as a point person for coordination with appropriate parties during a security incident – client, management, legal, security, operations, etc.

Create thorough reports and documentation of all incidents and procedures, presenting findings to team and leadership on a routine basis.

Incident Response: remote remediation when possible and working with onsite teams when necessary. Detailed documentation of events and remediation steps taken.

Root Cause Analysis: initiation and follow-through to ensure quality forensic materials are captured, writing reports with details and timelines of events with recommendations to avoid future occurrences.

Assist in the general maintenance and improvement of procedures, processes and playbooks.

Conduct research regarding the latest methods, tools, and trends in digital forensics analysis.

Conduct analysis using logs, previous alerts, etc. to identify trends to identify and prevent potential incidents.

Follow standard operating procedures (SOPs) to ensure tickets are triaged appropriately and in a timely manner, according to SLAs.

Excel at documentation and detailed notetaking, including SOP writing, incident reporting, e-mail and instant messaging etiquette, and most importantly, documenting incident actions in tickets. This role is responsible for completing incident reports and forensic reports, when appropriate, so competent writing skills are necessary.

Ability to know when to appropriately escalate a potential issue to peers and/or leadership.

Desire to learn new concepts and technologies to grow and take on more responsibility over time.

Ability to communicate risk, prioritize incident response actions, and keep a cool head under pressure.

Advanced experience with security tools like Splunk, CrowdStrike EDR, Carbon Black EDR, Proofpoint tools, Microsoft Defender components, Cyberhaven DLP, Axiom Cyber and open-source forensic tools, Cylance Protect, Office 365 tools, PowerShell, and various network tools, etc.

Understanding the various stages of incident response, the importance and critical factors of an investigation, and how to contain as soon as possible.

Have experience with the incident response lifecycle, the Lockheed Martin Cyber Kill Chain, the MITRE framework, and the forensic workflows as outlined by NIST.

Work with development teams to ensure they're using best practices and company processes in their daily activities.

Drive self-organization; help determine how the team functions in collaboration with your peers

Build strong relationships with cross-functional team members between the three tiers of the CSOC.

Participate in off-hours on-call incident handler rotation, which is a requirement for this role, as incidents may be escalated outside of normal business hours by our 24/7/365 Tier 2 team. Tier 3 teammates rotate on-call responsibilities which requires each teammate to be formally on-call roughly one week a month.

Typical Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree or higher in cyber security, computer science, or related field.

6-10 years of cyber security experience, including at least five years in an incident response role.

Completion of the GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH), GIAC Security Operations Certified (GSOC), GIAC Certified Forensic Examiner (GCFE), GIAC Certified Forensic Analyst (GCFA), or equivalent.

Experience with endpoint detection and response (EDR) solutions, including a fundamental understanding of memory processes and memory management practices for Windows, macOS, and Linux systems.

Information Security familiarity and training, including areas such as incident response, computer forensics (host and network-based), malware analysis, risk assessment, vulnerability testing, penetration testing, and insider threat investigations.

Experience participating in penetration tests, purple team exercises, and threat hunts, including remediation.

Experience in distributed systems and cloud-based architecture including Amazon AWS, Microsoft Azure, and the native security tools available in these environments (Data Explorer, GuardDuty, Log Analytics, etc.).

Experience with detection engineering for endpoint detection and response (EDR) solutions, Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) solutions such as Splunk and the Elastic Stack (ELK), and log analysis for all operating systems,

Familiarity with Unix/Linux, Windows, SQL, macOS, shell scripting, PowerShell and python scripting, and various other technologies.

Familiarity with common phishing attacks, methods, and risks to look out for from a security perspective.

Basic understanding and exposure to project management and collaborative software applications such as Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, ServiceNow, MS Teams, etc.

Have strong written and verbal communication skills and not be afraid to ask questions or for advice.

Be a strong team member, assertive, a critical thinker, and able to collaborate often and openly.

Good communication skills to interact with clients, team members, management, and support personnel.

The ability to work independently and as part of a team, be highly self-motivated.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Ability to prioritize work and complete tasks in a timely and complete manner with regular documentation along the way.

Work Environment:

Requires being on-call during off hours.

May require occasional weekend work.

Remote, but must be physically located within the USA.

Can reside anywhere in the USA, but must work in Eastern Standard Time (ET) (typically 8:30AM-5PM ET)

We're seeking an experienced Lead Member of Technical Staff to join our engineering team in Chennai. This hybrid role offers the opportunity to lead technical initiatives in modernizing our large-scale enterprise reporting platform, transitioning from monolithic OLTP architecture to cloud-native, self-service analytics. You'll work at the intersection of data modelling, cloud optimization, and full-stack development, directly impacting thousands of users. This position reports to the Senior Engineering Manager.

Team Summary

Our team is at the forefront of a transformative journey, modernizing athenahealth's enterprise reporting infrastructure. We're moving away from legacy monolithic systems toward a cloud-native, self-service analytics experience that empowers healthcare providers with real-time insights. The work encompasses data modeling excellence, query optimization at scale, cost and performance management, and leveraging LLMs to accelerate migration of complex SQL across dialects.

You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams including data engineers, product managers, and business analysts to deliver solutions that touch thousands of healthcare providers daily. Our tech stack includes Snowflake for data warehousing, Java and Node.js for backend services, React for frontend applications, PostgreSQL for transactional data, and AWS for cloud infrastructure. We value technical depth combined with systems thinking, and if you're passionate about transformation that requires both architectural vision and hands-on coding, we'd love to connect with you.

Essential Job Responsibilities

• Design and implement scalable data models in Snowflake, optimizing for performance and cost efficiency across multi-tenant architectures

• Develop full-stack solutions using Java/Node.js for backend services and React for frontend applications, ensuring seamless integration with data platforms.

• Deep knowledge on service-service authorization mechanisms via OAuth and other mechanisms. Knowledge on how RBAC policies work on a database like postgres.

• Architect and build web-stack solutions on AWS, implementing best practices for security, scalability, and reliability

• Lead technical design discussions and code reviews, mentoring team members on best practices and architectural patterns

• Collaborate with product and UX teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions, balancing immediate needs with long-term platform vision

• Drive query and cost optimization initiatives and warehouse performance tuning to support analytics at scale.

• Partner with stakeholders to establish data governance standards and implement self-service analytics capabilities

Additional Job Responsibilities

• Contribute to the migration strategy from legacy SQL systems to modern data platforms, leveraging automation where possible

• Understand and collaborate with the Cloud Engineering org for onboarding and scaling the app via EKS

• Support the integration of analytics platforms like Sigma or equivalent tools into the technology ecosystem

• Participate in on-call rotations to ensure platform reliability and performance

• Document architectural decisions and create technical specifications for complex features

• Contribute to the engineering community through knowledge sharing sessions and technical presentations

• Assist in evaluating new technologies and tools that could enhance our data and analytics capabilities

• Embrace help of AI and coding assistants and willing to work on perl based monolithic stack. Multiple coding assistants with access to Frontier models will be available for all engineers.

• Demonstrated knowledge of consistently leading a large feature that is a collection of multiple stories and tasks.

• Ability to mentor junior developers in the areas of security and privacy but not limited to this.

• Demonstrated ability of reviewing others code with empathy and yet uncompromising on security and privacy.

• Ability to balance stakeholder commitments vs code quality. Ability to articulate reality and find a way forward.

Expected Education & Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience

• 8-12 years of experience in software development with focus on enterprise-scale applications

• Strong expertise in data modelling

• Expertise in Snowflake or an equivalent cloud platform like Databricks - architecture, including warehouse optimization techniques

• Proficiency in full-stack development with Java and/or Node.js for backend, and React for frontend development.

• Experience with PostgreSQL or similar relational databases in production environments

• Demonstrated knowledge of AWS services and building cloud-native web applications

• Nice to have - Working knowledge of Kubernetes and container orchestration concepts

• Nice to have - Familiarity with analytics platforms such as Sigma or similar business intelligence tools

Clinical Decision Support Rule Author 

We are looking for a Clinical Content & Terminology Senior Associate to join our team within the Chief Medical Officer Organization division. Your job will include authoring new Clinical Decision Support (CDS) rules to expand and maintain a global CDS rule library that supports evidence-based, actionable guidance within athenahealth clinical workflows. 
 
You are a curious, logical thinker who enjoys breaking down complex guidance and seeing problems through to resolution. You prefer deep expertise in your area of focus while understanding how your work fits into the broader clinical and product ecosystem. You are detail-oriented, yet efficient, comfortable working independently, and proactive about identifying ambiguity or inconsistencies. You collaborate effectively with clinicians, project leaders, and cross-functional partners to ensure CDS rules are clinically accurate, technically feasible, and valuable to customers. 

The Team 

Our Clinical Content & Terminology team optimizes the client experience by curating clinically relevant content that is supported by evidence-based medicine and industry standard code sets. The standardization, management, and continuous improvement of these content assets is critical to supporting a positive customer experience that leads to exceptional patient care and contributes to the success of athenahealth’s clinical workflows. The team engages in the product development process to support content for new workflows and features. We curate content for workflows including templates, orders/results, clinical providers, patient health information sections, screening questionnaires, and care management. 

Job Responsibilities (Include but are not limited to) 

Perform clinical research to translate evidence-based clinical recommendations and guidance into structured, executable CDS rule logic 

Design logic diagrams to model rule behavior prior to implementation 

Collaborate with clinicians to validate clinical intent, scope, accuracy, and relevance of CDS rules 

Identify where required clinical information is documented within the patient chart and assess structured data availability 

Develop and maintain value sets (e.g., diagnoses, medications, labs, procedures) that support CDS logic 

Build, test, and refine CDS rules within the CDS platform or rules engine 

Develop and execute test cases to validate expected behavior, including edge cases and exceptions 

Troubleshoot rule behavior and data issues, identifying root causes and implementing improvements 

Prepare CDS rules for release, including documentation of assumptions, limitations, and intended behavior 

Respond to customer feedback and reported issues related to CDS content and rule behavior 

Coordinate with project leaders and cross-functional teams to resolve clinical, data, or technical inconsistencies 

Support continuous improvement of the CDS rule library through ongoing maintenance and enhancement 

​

Education, Experience & Skills 

Strong logical, analytical, and systems-thinking skills with the ability to translate narrative guidance into executable logic 

Ability to interpret clinical guidelines and ask effective clarifying questions of clinical subject matter experts 

Understanding how clinical data is documented in electronic health records (EHRs) 

Experience with medical coding systems and clinical terminology 

Comfort working with logic modeling tools, flowcharts, or rule authoring systems. 

Strong written and verbal communication skills 

Bachelor’s Degree preferred 

Professional experience in healthcare, health IT, informatics, data analysis, or related field preferred 

​

Behaviors & Abilities Required 

Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a cross-functional team 

Comfort operating in ambiguity and making reasoned decisions when guidance or data is incomplete 

Strong attention to detail balanced with efficiency and the ability to manage multiple priorities 

Proactive communicator who escalates risks, gaps, or inconsistencies early 

Strong problem-solving and analytical skills 

Adaptability and willingness to learn new clinical domains and technical systems 

Passion for improving healthcare and the clinician experience, with empathy for end users 

Excellent organizational, time-management, and prioritization skills in a fast-paced environment

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to join our API Traffic Management team, Tech Standardization within our Internal Platform subdivision.

Our vision is to maximize network effect through secure, resilient and high-performance API traffic management, enabling seamless API integrations across our platform and ecosystem while advancing value-based care.

The API Traffic Management team is responsible for building and operating the foundational API Gateway and Service Mesh platforms that power all north–south and east–west traffic across our cloud-native architecture. These platforms are critical to enabling scalable integrations, consistent security controls and reliable service-to-service communication across the enterprise.

We empower internal product teams, partners and external consumers with highly available, observable and policy-driven traffic infrastructure, ensuring that APIs and services can evolve independently while maintaining safety, performance and reliability.

In this role, you will lead high-performing engineers responsible for the API Gateway and Service Mesh roadmap, including availability, scalability, security and operational excellence. You are a hands-on technical leader with a passion for distributed systems, cloud infrastructure and developer experience. Your work will directly enable our mission of becoming the backbone of healthcare—so clinicians can focus on patient care while the platform just works.

Job Responsibilities

· People Management & Development

Lead, mentor, coach and support the career growth of engineers through regular 1:1s, performance reviews, feedback and individualized development plans.

· Hiring & Team Building Recruit, interview and onboard top-tier platform and infrastructure engineers to scale and strengthen the API Traffic Management team.

· Platform Roadmap Ownership Own and evolve the roadmap for API traffic management capabilities, including API Gateway, service mesh, ingress/egress, routing, resiliency, security and observability.

· High Availability & Reliability Ensure the API Gateway and service mesh platforms meet stringent availability,

latency and resiliency requirements, including multi-AZ/multi-region strategies, disaster recovery and incident response readiness.

· Technical Leadership & Architecture Provide strong guidance on traffic patterns, API lifecycle management, service-to-service communication, rate limiting, authentication/authorization and zero-trust networking. Work with Architects to ensure designs are scalable, secure and aligned with enterprise standards.

· Execution & Delivery Drive execution, remove blockers, manage dependencies and ensure timely delivery of high-quality platform capabilities used by internal services and external consumers.

· Operational Excellence Champion best practices in reliability engineering, observability, on-call health, incident management and post-incident learning to continuously improve platform stability.

· Process Optimization Continuously improve engineering workflows, release processes and Agile practices to balance speed, safety and platform reliability.

· Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner closely with product, security, cloud infrastructure, developer enablement and application teams to align traffic management capabilities with business and platform needs.

· Developer Experience & Adoption Advocate for a strong internal developer experience by providing paved roads, clear abstractions, documentation and self-service capabilities for API and service mesh consumers.

· Strategic Input & Innovation Contribute to broader platform and cloud strategy, evaluate emerging technologies and guide experimentation in areas such as advanced routing, policy engines and service identity.

Typical Qualifications

· 12+ Years of Software Engineering Experience Strong background in building and operating distributed systems, platforms or infrastructure at scale.

· 3+ Years of People Management Experience Proven ability to lead, mentor, and grow high-performing engineering teams.

· Deep Technical Expertise in Platform & Networking Domains Strong understanding of API Gateways, Service Mesh technologies, L7/L4 networking concepts, traffic routing, load balancing and service-to-service communication in cloud-native environments.

· Experience with Cloud & Kubernetes Ecosystems Hands-on experience with Kubernetes-based platforms and cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred), including ingress, egress and service networking patterns.

· Reliability & Availability Mindset Demonstrated experience designing and operating highly available, resilient systems, with familiarity in SRE practices, SLIs/SLOs, incident management and operational maturity.

· Agile Delivery Expertise Proficiency in Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and experience applying them to platform teams.

· Excellent Communication & Stakeholder Management Ability to clearly communicate technical concepts, influence across teams and align stakeholders on priorities and trade-offs.

· Hiring & Team Scaling Experience Proven track record of attracting, hiring and retaining top engineering talent and fostering an inclusive, high-trust team culture.

· Problem Solving & Strategic Leadership Ability to navigate complex technical and organizational challenges, make sound decisions and align team outcomes with business objectives.

· Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or Related Field Or equivalent practical experience in software or platform engineering.

Nice to Have

· Experience with API Gateway platforms such as Apigee, Kong, NGINX, AWS API Gateway or similar

· Hands-on exposure to Service Mesh technologies like Istio, Linkerd, Consul or Envoy

· Experience operating large-scale Kubernetes platforms in production environments

From onboarding and data intake to ongoing imports, validation, monitoring, and support, these services must work together as a coherent whole to earn trust and scale reliably. 

This role exists to bring clarity, direction, and momentum to the seams between systems, services, and people, especially where ownership spans teams, platforms, and operational groups. When data services work well, clinicians can focus on care instead of systems, teams move faster with less rework, issues are surfaced and resolved earlier, and decisions improve across the organization. You’ll set direction across seams, connecting customer experience, internal operations, and platform capabilities into a coherent service model. Position Summary – Account Executive, Small Group Sales 

We are seeking a high-energy, consultative Account Executive to accelerate growth within our existing Small Group (1–5 MD) client base. This is a true farming role, focused on expanding revenue through strategic prospecting, opportunity identification, and closing new business across an assigned portfolio of existing clients within the Small Group Existing Logo segment. 

In this high-impact role, the Account Executive will own the full sales cycle—from discovery through close—while building trusted, long-term relationships with physicians and practice leadership. The ideal candidate operates as a strategic partner, leveraging deep healthcare expertise, strong client relationships, and commercial acumen to uncover growth opportunities and expand athenahealth’s footprint within each practice. 

This role requires a proven seller who can translate complex clinical, operational, and financial challenges into clear, value-driven solutions. The Account Executive will position athenahealth’s expanding and extended revenue cycle services to optimize both clinical performance and financial outcomes, increase wallet share, and deliver measurable value to clients. 

About the Team 

The Small Group Account Executive team is a fast-moving, high-growth organization focused on service line expansion and wallet share. Account Executives are aligned to geographically defined markets and partner closely with Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to bring athenahealth’s extended revenue cycle services to clients already live on athena’s core platform. 

As a member of this team, you will gain early exposure to testing, launching, and scaling new services, building expertise in athenahealth’s expanding portfolio ahead of other sales segments. The team culture is highly collaborative and supportive—you’ll receive regular coaching from your Territory Sales Manager, collaborate with peers on complex opportunities, and have direct access to product and customer success partners when needed. 

Using virtual selling tools, data-driven insights, and a team-based approach, this group helps practices launch, scale, and succeed. Wins are celebrated collectively, losses are treated as learning opportunities, and the work you do directly fuels athenahealth’s growth and long-term impact on healthcare. 

 

Essential Job Responsibilities 

65% – Driving Bookings from New Services within Existing Clients 

Meet or exceed assigned New Services quota. 

Convert open sockets within the assigned book of business by upgrading existing clients to new services. 

Proactively generate pipeline through targeted prospecting leveraging internal resources (client performance data, CSM partnerships, and established client relationships). This is a hunter role within the existing client base, focused on securing meetings with economic and clinical decision makers. Maintain a minimum 2x quota pipeline. 

Lead with athena’s Extended Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) services. Demonstrate deep fluency across RCM and conduct rigorous discovery to uncover operational and financial pain points, including billing, coding, denials, days in A/R, collection rates, patient responsibility, and payer performance. 

Partner with practice administrators, physician owners, and billing leaders to navigate buying decisions and overcome objections related to vendor change and service transitions. 

Own the end-to-end sales process, including prospecting, executive presentations, total cost of ownership analysis, follow-up, negotiation, and proposal delivery. 

Rapidly ramp on and effectively sell newly launched athenahealth products and services. 

Maintain accurate, timely pipeline reporting and forecasting. 

 

35% – Driving Bookings from Client Growth Events 

Meet or exceed assigned growth-related quota. 

Build and sustain strong relationships with key client decision makers. 

Consistently articulate and defend athena’s value proposition and total cost of ownership, leveraging growth events as catalysts to expand adoption of additional, non-departmental services. 

Engage clients in forward-looking conversations related to practice growth, including new locations, new specialties, and Tax ID expansions. 

Demonstrate fluency in Management Services Organization (MSO) structures. 

Understand client contractual frameworks and negotiate pricing and terms associated with expansion. 

 

Travel Requirements 

Regular travel within the assigned market to support pipeline development, client engagement, and deal progression. 

Expected travel cadence of approximately 1–2 trips per quarter, aligned to business needs and growth opportunities. 

 

Skills & Qualifications 

Strong executive presence with demonstrated business acumen. 

Proven ability to influence, negotiate, and manage complex buying processes. 

Exceptional discovery, storytelling, and objection-handling skills. 

Proficiency with Salesforce, Excel (financial modeling), PowerPoint (executive presentations), Gong/Chorus, Outreach, LinkedIn, and GPT-based tools. 

Ability to build and sustain strong internal and external relationships across multiple levels. 

Demonstrated ability to independently manage a high-velocity pipeline of 25+ opportunities, driving speed and precision through the sales cycle with an average cycle time of <14 days. 

 

Experience 

5+ years of full-cycle healthcare or healthcare IT sales experience (existing-logo and/or new-logo). 

Deep expertise in end-to-end Revenue Cycle Management within ambulatory care settings. 

Experience carrying multimillion-dollar quotas with a consistent record of exceeding targets.

Contribute actively to Agile ceremonies to drive continuous improvement

Support a culture of self-organization, peer reviews, and knowledge sharing

Familiarity with event-driven architectures, GraphQL, AI/ML platforms, or agent frameworks a plus

Experience in an Agile environment, SDLC, deployment, and operational support of scalable services

Knowledge of core web and cloud fundamentals: HTTP, REST, APIs, Public Cloud (AWS preferred)

Understanding of API gateway patterns and microservices design

Experience with FHIR standards and healthcare interoperability preferred

Understanding of authentication models (OAuth 2.0, JWT, API tokens) and authorization patterns (RBAC, ABAC)

Experience building scalable APIs and microservices in public cloud environments

Familiarity with containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines

CORP

Lead Member Technical Staff (Network Engineering – Tech Ops)

Role Summary

The Lead Network Engineer will act as the primary point of contact for the Chennai site, but flexible to travel to Pune/Bangalore, responsible for resolving complex network issues ranging from large-scale wireless incidents to physical layer problems. The role involves vendor coordination, collaboration with peer teams, and leadership during major incidents. We are seeking a subject matter expert in Wireless networking (Aruba) with hands-on experience in Aruba ClearPass, Palo Alto (including GlobalProtect), Dell SONiC, and SD-WAN solutions.

Key Responsibilities

 Serve as the primary escalation point for Chennai site network issues across LAN, WAN, WLAN, and security layers.

 Install, configure, upgrade, and maintain networking and security equipment in a multi-vendor environment (Juniper, Aruba, Palo Alto, Dell SONiC, NSX, VeloCloud, etc.).

 Lead troubleshooting of complex incidents, including wireless, firewall, VPN, and routing/switching problems.

 Actively participate in a 24x7 on-call rotation and provide onsite leadership during critical events.

 Coordinate with service providers, hardware/software vendors, and technical support partners to drive issue resolution.

 Track, report, and proactively address network capacity and performance concerns.

 Provision and manage site-to-site IPSEC VPNs and WAN connectivity with LECs/IXCs. Ensure adherence to IT change control and incident management best practices.

 Collaborate with peer engineering teams to support network design, automation, and long-term strategy.

 Alongside Chennai, provide onsite support at Bangalore or Pune when required for major incidents or implementations

Education & Experience

 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).

 10+ years of professional experience in network engineering, including production 24x7 environments.

 Proven expertise in Wireless implementation, operations, and troubleshooting (Aruba preferred).

 Strong multi-vendor background: Juniper, Aruba, Palo Alto (+GlobalProtect), Dell SONiC, VeloCloud. Deep understanding of TCP/IP, routing, and switching protocols.

 Experience with firewall, VPN, and security technologies (Palo Alto strongly preferred). 

Familiarity with public and private cloud networking.

 Working knowledge of Linux OS networking stack troubleshooting.

 Understanding of structured cabling standards and physical layer troubleshooting.

Skills & Attributes

 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; able to resolve complex technical issues independently.

 Effective stakeholder management; able to collaborate across global teams.

 Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

 Ability to prioritize and multitask in high-pressure environments.

 Strong organizational skills with proven experience managing projects and deadlines. 

Desire and ability to continuously learn and mentor others.

 Bonus: Hands-on experience with Ansible, Git, Python, EVPN/VXLAN. Knowledge of MacOS and Windows at the OS level is an advantage

Renewal Management
• Execute end to end renewal motions independently, streamlining workflows and reducing manual effort.
Territory Coverage
• Provide renewals coverage across a broad range of segmented accounts, prioritizing by spend, complexity, and growth potential.
Close Renewals
• Defend the current customer base by accurately and independently executing renewals.
Sales Expansion
• Drive and close seat expansions at renewal using standard playbooks with minimal supervision
Auto Renewal Management

CRM Hygiene & Forecasting

• Organizational & Time Management: Handles high volume renewal cycles efficiently and independently.

Sales Team Collaboration
• Expansion Qualification: Partner with Account Representatives to initiate larger cross sell or expansion motions.
• Partner Engagement: Provide light touch support for partner owned accounts with minimal guidance.
• Insights & Reporting: Share churn indicators, renewal blockers, and upsell signals across teams.
• Feedback Loop: Offer insights on packaging and product improvements based on customer patterns.

Required Qualifications
• 2–4 years of experience in inside sales, renewals, account management, or customer success, preferably in software/SaaS environments.
• Demonstrated ability to independently execute high volume renewals.
• Experience using CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce, Dynamics) to manage renewal workflows.
• Proven communication and negotiation skills with the ability to influence customer decisions.
• Ability to work autonomously, multitask, and prioritize across a large territory.

• Native-level French & English proficiency

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with subscription or recurring revenue business models.
• Background in data driven churn analysis or customer retention strategies.

We are seeking a Sr People Business Partner (PBP), an advanced People strategist and trusted advisor who operates at senior leadership altitude and brings independent judgment, enterprise perspective, and strong executive influence.

This role is designed for an experienced Senior PBP who goes beyond program execution to shape people strategy, influence leadership decisions, and proactively address complex organizational challenges. You will partner closely with Vice Presidents in a dynamic, global, and evolving business environment, helping leaders translate business strategy into sustainable organizational outcomes.

As a Sr PBP, you will be expected to think ahead of the business, diagnose root causes, frame complex people and organizational issues, and recommend integrated, forward-looking solutions. You will also represent the PBP community in strategic initiatives and help elevate how People & Places work is delivered across the organization.

This role reports to the Senior Director, People Business Partner. This position will be based in Toronto, Montreal or Vancouver.

Responsibilities

Strategic Business Partnership & Advisory

Act as a trusted advisor to senior leaders (VP/SVP level), providing independent perspective, challenge, and counsel on organizational effectiveness, leadership capability, and talent strategy

Translate business strategy into an integrated people strategy spanning workforce planning, organizational design, leadership capability, talent, and performance

Proactively identify emerging organizational risks and opportunities, frame ambiguity and present clear options and trade-offs to leaders

Organizational Effectiveness & Change

Drive and influence established organizational interventions to support business objectives, ensuring solutions are contextually grounded and scalable

Anticipate organizational reactions to change and guide leaders through complex transitions with clarity and discipline

Partner with leaders to build operating models, structures, and capabilities that enable execution today while preparing for future-state needs

Executive Coaching & Leadership Effectiveness

Provide executive coaching and consultation to senior leaders, influencing leadership behavior, decision-making, and effectiveness

Support leaders through moments of tension, trade-offs, and ambiguity, helping turn disagreement into aligned decisions

Elevate leadership capability across performance, talent decisions, and team dynamics

Talent, Workforce & Performance Strategy

Assess current and emerging talent needs; contribute to and shape talent initiatives aligned to business priorities

Guide performance, development, and career processes to ensure leadership depth and future readiness

Ensure total rewards and recognition approaches are aligned with performance, business outcomes, and organizational values

Data, Insight & Judgment

Leverage people and business data to extract meaning, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable recommendations

Apply strong judgment in selecting the most relevant data to inform decisions without slowing execution

Connect people insights to business outcomes, including efficiency, growth capacity, and leadership effectiveness

Enterprise & Cross-Functional Partnership

Partner closely with Centers of Excellence (OE, L&D, Compensation, Talent Acquisition, Inclusion & Belonging) to address complex or novel business needs

Represent the PBP community on strategic, cross-functional initiatives and influence how People & Places solutions are delivered

Collaborate with internal partners to support M&A, integration, and other enterprise initiatives as required

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree required.

10+ years of HR experience, including 7+ years as an HRBP/PBP supporting senior leaders in complex, global environments

Expertise across multiple HR disciplines, including: organizational design, talent strategy, workforce planning, performance management, org transformation, executive coaching, employee relations, and change management

Ability to influence senior leaders, frame complex organizational problems, and recommend strategic solutions

Strong business acumen, including understanding of operating models, organizational structures, and the implications of people decisions on business outcomes

Ability to use qualitative and quantitative data to inform decisions and shape leadership thinking

Comfort operating in ambiguity and fast-paced, evolving environments

Curiosity and appetite to leverage AI and emerging tools to improve efficiency and effectiveness

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s degree in Organizational Development, Business Administration, Industrial/Labor Relations, or related field

Executive or professional coaching accreditation

Experience partnering with technology, engineering, or product-driven organizations

Demonstrated success operating across matrixed, global organizations

Experience influencing or representing People strategy at an enterprise or cross-functional level

The Ideal Candidate

Leaders seek you out as a thought partner, not just a service provider

Organizational issues are surfaced earlier, framed clearly, and addressed with durable solutions

Leadership capability, clarity, and decision quality improve within your client group

People strategy is visibly aligned to business outcomes and future readiness

You are recognized as a Senior PBP expert within the People & Places community

Présentation du poste

Nous recherchons un Sr People Business Partner (PBP), qui soit un stratège expérimenté et un conseiller de confiance, capable d'évoluer au niveau de la haute direction et d'apporter un jugement indépendant, une perspective d'entreprise et une forte influence exécutive.

Ce rôle est destiné à un Senior PBP expérimenté qui va au-delà de l'exécution de programmes pour façonner la stratégie des ressources humaines, influencer les décisions de leadership et relever de manière proactive des défis organisationnels complexes. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les vice-présidents dans un environnement commercial dynamique, international et en évolution, en aidant les dirigeants à traduire la stratégie commerciale en résultats organisationnels durables.

En tant que Sr PBP, vous devrez anticiper les besoins de l'entreprise, diagnostiquer les causes profondes, cerner les problèmes complexes liés aux ressources humaines et à l'organisation, et recommander des solutions intégrées et tournées vers l'avenir. Vous représenterez également la communauté PBP dans le cadre d'initiatives stratégiques et contribuerez à améliorer la façon dont le travail des Personnes et lieux est mené à bien dans l'ensemble de l'organisation.

Ce rôle est rattaché au directeur principal, partenaire d'affaires des Ressources humaines. Ce poste sera et basé à Toronto, Montréal, ou Vancouver.

Responsabilités

Partenariat d'affaires stratégique et conseil

Agir à titre de conseiller de confiance auprès des cadres supérieurs (niveau vice-président/vice-président à la direction), en fournissant un point de vue indépendant, en remettant en question et en donnant des conseils sur l'efficacité organisationnelle, la capacité de leadership et la stratégie en matière de talents

Traduire la stratégie commerciale en une stratégie intégrée en matière de ressources humaines couvrant la planification de la main-d'œuvre, la conception organisationnelle, la capacité de leadership, les talents et les performances

Identifier de manière proactive les risques et les occasions organisationnels émergents, clarifier les ambiguïtés et présenter des options et des compromis clairs aux dirigeants

Efficacité organisationnelle et changement

Diriger et influencer les interventions organisationnelles établies afin de soutenir les objectifs commerciaux, en veillant à ce que les solutions soient adaptées au contexte et évolutives

Anticiper les réactions organisationnelles face au changement et guider les dirigeants à travers les transitions complexes avec clarté et discipline

Collaborer avec les dirigeants pour créer des modèles opérationnels, des structures et des capacités qui permettent d'agir dès aujourd'hui tout en préparant les besoins futurs

Accompagnement des cadres et efficacité du leadership

Fournir un accompagnement et des conseils aux cadres supérieurs, afin d'influencer les comportements de leadership, la prise de décision et l'efficacité

Soutenir les dirigeants dans les moments de tension, de compromis et d'ambiguïté, en les aidant à transformer les désaccords en décisions concertées

Améliorer les capacités de leadership en matière de performances, de décisions relatives aux talents et de dynamiques d'équipe

Stratégie en matière de talents, de main-d'œuvre et de performance

Évaluer les besoins actuels et émergents en matière de talents; contribuer à l'élaboration et à la mise en œuvre d'initiatives en matière de talents alignées sur les priorités commerciales

Orienter les processus de performance, de développement et de carrière afin de garantir la profondeur du leadership et la préparation pour l'avenir

Veiller à ce que les approches en matière de rémunération globale et de reconnaissance sont alignées sur la performance, les résultats commerciaux et les valeurs organisationnelles

Données, informations et jugement

Exploiter les données relatives aux personnes et à l'entreprise pour en extraire du sens, identifier les tendances et traduire les informations en recommandations exploitables

Faire preuve d'un jugement sûr dans la sélection des données les plus pertinentes pour prendre des décisions éclairées sans ralentir leur exécution

Relier les informations sur les personnes aux résultats commerciaux, notamment le rendement, la capacité de croissance et l'efficacité du leadership

Partenariat interentreprises et interfonctionnel

Collaborer étroitement avec les centres d'excellence (OE, L&D, rémunération, acquisition de talents, inclusion et appartenance) pour répondre aux besoins commerciaux complexes ou nouveaux

Représenter la communauté PBP dans le cadre d'initiatives stratégiques interfonctionnelles et influencer la façon dont les solutions Personnes et lieux sont mises en œuvre

Collaborer avec des partenaires internes pour soutenir les fusions et acquisitions, l'intégration et d'autres initiatives d'entreprise, selon les besoins

Compétences minimales

Baccalauréat requis.

Plus de 10 ans d'expérience en RH, dont plus de 7 ans en tant que PARH/PBP auprès de cadres supérieurs dans des environnements internationaux complexes

Expertise dans plusieurs disciplines des RH, notamment : conception organisationnelle, stratégie en matière de talents, planification de la main-d'œuvre, gestion de la performance, transformation organisationnelle, accompagnement des cadres, relations avec les employés et gestion du changement

Capacité à influencer les cadres supérieurs, à cerner les problèmes organisationnels complexes et à recommander des solutions stratégiques

Sens aigu des affaires, notamment compréhension des modèles opérationnels, des structures organisationnelles et des répercussions des décisions relatives au personnel sur les résultats commerciaux

Capacité à utiliser des données qualitatives et quantitatives pour prendre des décisions éclairées et façonner la réflexion en matière de leadership

À l'aise dans les situations ambiguës et les environnements en constante et rapide évolution

Curiosité et envie d'exploiter l'IA et les nouveaux outils pour améliorer le rendement et l'efficacité

Compétences souhaitées

Maîtrise en développement organisationnel, en administration des affaires, en relations industrielles/professionnelles ou dans un domaine connexe

Accréditation en accompagnement des cadres ou des professionnels

Expérience en partenariats avec des organisations axées sur la technologie, l'ingénierie ou les produits

Succès avéré dans le cadre d'organisations matricielles et internationales

Expérience dans l'influence ou la représentation de la stratégie des ressources humaines au niveau de l'entreprise ou interfonctionnel

Le candidat idéal

Les dirigeants vous recherchent en tant que partenaire de réflexion, et pas seulement comme un prestataire de services

Les problèmes organisationnels sont identifiés plus tôt, clairement définis et traités à l'aide de solutions durables

Les capacités de leadership, la clarté et la qualité des décisions s'améliorent au sein de votre groupe de clients

La stratégie en matière de ressources humaines est clairement alignée sur les résultats commerciaux et la préparation à l'avenir

Vous êtes reconnu en tant qu'expert principal PBP au sein de la communauté Personnes et lieux

Optical Fabrication Technician

Back End Nights 6pm – 6am (Thursday night, Friday, Saturday, alternate Wednesday nights)

Introduction to the role:

You will fabricate some of the world’s most advanced optical components used in the most advanced semiconductor photolithography machines. Through your attention to detail, results orientation, and commitment to task, you will produce high precision quality optics per production schedule. You will maintain the safety and workplace organization of your processing area. You will value adherence to standards while applying your experience and perspective to contribute to continuous improvement in our processing methods. You will enjoy success generated through your individual desire to learn and through teamwork with your colleagues.

We are looking for individuals like you to work in one of our processing competencies. These include: machining glass materials into final configuration using CNC milling equipment; grinding and polishing surfaces of optical components to rigorous dimensional and surface quality specifications; loading material into and operating deposition chambers to coat optics; precisely align and assemble glass parts with a high degree of accuracy in order to produce high quality optical assemblies; measuring optical characteristics of components using advanced metrology equipment for in process material processing feedback and final quality inspection.

Role & Responsibilities:

Back End Nights 6pm – 6am (Thursday night, Friday, Saturday, alternate Wednesday nights)

Must be willing to work a compressed work week schedule- twelve-hour long shift and rotating from three to four days a week.

Actively monitor and take ownership of optical processing equipment

Handle delicate optical components and visually identify any abnormal characteristics.

Maintain area, tooling, and equipment to 5S area standards.

Identify and escalate any unsafe conditions.

Identify and escalate any product or process quality concerns in a timely manner.

Perform assigned work content to support area and factory schedule execution.

Collaborate with the Production Engineering and Manufacturing Management teams to improve operational efficiency and effectivity.

Learn and apply skills to tackle progressively more challenging products.

Identify and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives in how your work is defined and performed, and more broadly within your area, to improve safety, quality, output, and cycle time.

Inspect and create a map of glass surfaces showing all minute defects.

Clean optical surfaces of all particles and contaminants.

Accurately record time and attendance.

Assist with training new and existing employees

Education & Experience:

High school diploma or GED required or equivalent experience.

Associate degree in a vocational trade preferred.

Previous experience working in a manufacturing facility or completion of a vocational certification preferable.

Prior use of some of the following: measuring equipment desirable: microscopes, calipers, micrometers, coordinate measuring machine (CMM), interferometer.

Participation in continuous improvement efforts (quality circles, kaizen events, etc.)

Skills:

Commitment to task and results orientation to complete scheduled activities and report status throughout your shift.

Attention to detail to deliver quality results from your processing step, including visually inspecting your work to detect and report any abnormalities.

Organization of information and materials.

Ability to read and understand gages and other measuring devices.

Ability to interpret mathematical and geometrical data. An example would be experience reading and interpreting topographical maps.

Ability to effectively communicate written and verbal information.

Demonstrated ability to clearly document a problem using facts and data.

Accountable for your actions and willingness to engage in problem resolution.

Constructively challenge the status quo in search of a better way.

Care for yourself and others by confronting unsafe behaviors or conditions.

Take pride in your work and speak up when observing abnormal conditions in process or product.

Self-motivated learner.

Dexterity to handle optical components with care.

Other Information:

Routinely required to sit; walk; talk; hear; use hands to keyboard, finger, handle, and feel; stoop, kneel, crouch, twist, reach, and stretch. Occasionally required to move around the campus.

May require travel dependent on business needs.

Must be willing to work in a clean room environment, wearing coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses and gloves for entire duration of shift.

The employee may occasionally lift and/or move up to 35 pounds. 

Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

Must be comfortable working around lasers, working with ladders, working on platforms, and working around chemicals.

Must be able to work in a moderate to high noise level environment in a temperature-controlled environment

Must be comfortable operating/working around overhead cranes, fork trucks and motorized pallet movers. 

May be exposed to moving mechanical parts, solvents and tooling.

Additional Responsibilities:

There is potential for exposure to strong magnetic fields, high voltage and currents.

Overview

The Senior Renewals Representative, Account Based leads the optimization of workflows for high-volume renewal cycles, develops and implements strategies for engaging Account Executives (AEs), and provides specialized knowledge and guidance to partners. Customer Procurement Interaction: Lead interactions with customer procurement teams to ensure successful renewal execution.

ATU Collaboration: Engage Account Executives for larger cross-sell or expansion opportunities, support partners, and share insights on churn risks and renewal blockers.

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

3+ years in inside sales, renewals, account management, or customer success (preferably in software/SaaS).

Demonstrated ability to lead and optimize high-volume renewal cycles.

Proven track record in closing renewals and driving seat expansions.

Strong organizational and time management skills, with experience mentoring others.

Advanced communication and negotiation skills.

Experience with CRM and renewal tracking systems, including developing automation workflows.

Customer-first mindset with a focus on satisfaction and retention.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in the software or SaaS industry.

Experience leading cross-functional teams or initiatives.

Advanced skills in strategic analysis, identifying churn risks, and renewal blockers.

Experience providing specialized guidance to partners and collaborating with Account Executives.

Ability to develop and implement advanced automation workflows in CRM systems.

Strong analytical skills and the ability to share insights across teams and geographies.

This role is focused on understanding how Finance applications work across the landscape—ERP, upstream/downstream integrations, data flows, and reporting—and partnering with Finance stakeholders and Engineering teams to validate that releases perform correctly in real business scenarios.
 

The position plays a key contributing role in Finance UAT across Autodesk’s SAP Finance landscape, helping ensure system changes meet business outcomes, internal controls, and compliance standards. While this role does not own the overall UAT program, it is critical to planning test coverage, executing E2E scenarios, identifying defects early, and driving resolution through clear evidence and collaboration.
 

Key Responsibilities
 

Application Systems Expertise & Release Readiness

Develop strong functional and technical understanding of Autodesk’s Finance application ecosystem, primarily SAP Finance, including key integrations, master data dependencies, and reporting outputs

Perform impact analysis for changes across E2E Finance flows (e.g., Order-to-Cash, Record-to-Report, Revenue, Billing, Payments, Intercompany), identifying affected systems, interfaces, controls, and downstream consumers

Partner with Engineering, Product, and Finance stakeholders to understand intended changes and translate them into test coverage and release readiness criteria (entry/exit)

Support environment and data readiness for UAT (test data setup, prerequisite configuration, reference data, and access), coordinating with relevant teams

Review release notes, design artifacts, and technical details (integration mappings, interface specs, data transformations) to anticipate testing risks and edge cases
 

End-to-End Business UAT (Primary Focus)

Design, build, and execute E2E UAT scenarios that reflect real business operations and validate cross-system behavior—from upstream transaction creation through ERP postings and downstream reporting/analytics

Create and maintain UAT test cases, scripts, and evidence that are auditable and traceable to business outcomes and control requirements

Validate accounting impact and system behavior including postings, document flow, tax/FX, revenue recognition outcomes, period-end processing, and management reporting outputs as applicable

Execute both positive and negative tests, including boundary conditions and integration failure scenarios (e.g., interface errors, timing issues, data quality breaks)

Log defects with clear reproduction steps, screenshots/logs, expected vs. actual results, and business impact; partner with Engineering teams through triage, fix validation, and regression testing

Participate in select PST-hour meetings during testing cycles (handoffs, triage, status) to improve collaboration and reduce cycle time

Contribute to continuous improvement of Finance UAT processes, tooling, templates, and test repositories
 

Quality, Controls & Compliance

Ensure testing aligns with internal control expectations (including SOX-relevant processes), documenting evidence and outcomes required for audit readiness

Identify and communicate risks related to testing gaps, control impacts, or deferred scope; recommend mitigation and retest plans

Support sign-off readiness by summarizing test results, open defects, residual risk, and recommended go/no-go considerations
 

Stakeholder Partnership (Focused on Testing and System Outcomes)

Work closely with Finance stakeholders to validate business scenarios, confirm expected outcomes, and ensure UAT reflects operational reality

Coordinate with US-based testing leads, Project Managers, and global teams on schedules, handoffs, and execution status

Explain system behavior and testing findings in clear business terms, helping stakeholders make informed release decisions
 

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field

Professional certifications such as CA, CPA, CMA, or relevant QA/testing certifications (e.g., ISTQB) are preferred

8–10+ years of experience working with enterprise application systems supporting Finance processes (ERP and integrated systems), with significant hands-on involvement in business UAT

Strong hands-on experience with SAP Finance modules and processes; experience with SAP Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR) and Management Reporting (MR) is highly desirable

Proven experience designing and executing E2E test scenarios across multiple systems and integrations (APIs, middleware, batch interfaces), including defect triage and regression testing

Experience working in global, cross-functional teams and collaborating effectively across time zones

Strong understanding of Finance processes and accounting concepts, with the ability to validate ERP postings and reporting outputs

Position Overview

Autodesk's Technical Advisory organization is transforming how implementation expertise reaches customers. We are building a systematic capability to capture, structure, and publish innovation and implementation expertise as scalable digital content through our digital offerings.

The Senior Manager, Content & Knowledge will lead the team responsible for this end-to-end knowledge pipeline — from capturing field intelligence through customer-facing publication. Reporting to the Director of Platform & Productization within Global Delivery & Solutions, you will manage a multidisciplinary team of approximately analysts and specialists who form the critical bridge between consulting delivery and the digital platform.

In the first year, you will prove the knowledge pipeline works — capturing implementation expertise from consulting engagements and publishing the first customer-facing knowledge assets through the platform. You will also establish the quality standards and lifecycle governance — capture, validate, publish, retire — that make knowledge trustworthy at scale.

This is a building role. You will define the processes, quality standards, and success metrics for a maturing capability at Autodesk. The right person brings both intellectual rigor about knowledge management and practical instincts about what consultants will actually adopt.

Responsibilities

Knowledge Capture and Curation

Own the knowledge capture process design and operation, starting with manual consultant interviews and evolving toward platform-integrated capture as our digital offering matures

Define what constitutes a useful record of implementation — the right level of contextual detail, artifact organization, provenance, and narrative that makes knowledge reusable across engagements

Establish lifecycle governance for knowledge assets: capture, validation, publication, versioning, and retirement, ensuring content remains accurate and current as Autodesk products and customer practices evolve

Partner with consulting delivery leadership globally to drive knowledge contribution adoption, designing incentives and workflows that embed capture into the natural rhythm of engagements

Knowledge Synthesis and Publication

Lead the team that synthesizes across multiple implementation records to identify patterns, create structured knowledge assets, and prepare content in the platform data model

Partner with product management to determine which knowledge assets should be productized and through which channels, providing readiness assessments and market value input

Develop production workflows for creating customer-ready content at scale, with clear quality gates and editorial standards

Define and track metrics that demonstrate maturing knowledge management capability: volume and quality of knowledge captured, reuse rates, time savings for consultants, content published and consumed through the platform

Team Leadership

Lead, develop, and grow a new content and knowledge team, establishing role clarity and career paths for a discipline that is new within our organization

Hire and onboard new team members as the function scales

Coordinate with Architecture and Engineering on knowledge data model requirements and ingestion pipeline design — you own what knowledge looks like, they own how it's stored and served

Provide regular reporting to leadership on knowledge pipeline performance, adoption, and business impact

3+ years of experience developing teams

Track record of building cross-functional collaboration with technical and non-technical stakeholders

Strong analytical skills with ability to define and measure success for ambiguous, emerging capabilities

Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent professional experience

The Ideal Candidate

Has worked in professional services, consulting, or implementation delivery and understands what consultants do on engagements

Has built knowledge management, information management, or content operations functions from early stage — comfortable defining process before having technology to automate it

HR services including talent, learning, consulting, and workforce programs

Lead resolution of complex sourcing challenges requiring cross-functional coordination

Establish and track performance metrics focused on cost efficiency, service quality, and value delivery

Lead supplier governance reviews and continuous improvement initiatives

Support responsible sourcing, ESG, and sustainability expectations across the supplier ecosystem

Support adoption of intake, sourcing, and contract enablement tools

Drive increased spend under active management across Corporate Services categories

Share market intelligence and best practices across the Procurement organization

Position Overview 
 

We are seeking a Senior Analyst, Revenue Strategy and Operations to support enterprise revenue strategy and execution across Autodesk’s global go-to-market organization. This role plays a critical role in enabling data-driven decision-making, supporting all facets of pipeline management and hygiene including development of metrics, tracking, reporting and providing insights to drive pipeline velocity and close rates across Sales and Marketing in our APAC region.

Reporting to the Senior Director of Revenue Strategy and Operations, this role will work closely with partners across Sales, Sales Strategy, Marketing, Finance, and GTM Operations to analyze pipeline and revenue performance, generate insights, and support the execution of high-impact revenue initiatives. The Senior Analyst operates at the intersection of strategy, analytics, and execution, helping translate complex data into actionable recommendations that drive measurable business outcomes. 

 

Responsibilities 
 

Analyze pipeline and revenue performance: Evaluate pipeline health, bookings, and revenue trends across sales motions including new business, expansion, and renewals to inform GTM strategy and execution 

Support pipeline health and inspection: Analyze coverage, conversion, velocity, stage progression, and risk indicators to surface insights that improve pipeline quality and predictability 

Enable forecasting and performance management: Support revenue forecasting processes through analytical inputs, variance analysis, and performance tracking to improve forecast accuracy and confidence 

Develop pipeline and revenue analytics: Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and analytical frameworks that provide visibility into pipeline health, revenue performance, and leading indicators 

Support revenue operating cadence: Prepare analytical materials and insights for pipeline reviews, forecast calls, monthly business reviews, and quarterly strategy reviews 

Conduct deep-dive performance analysis: Identify trends, risks, opportunities, and root causes impacting pipeline and revenue performance, and translate findings into actionable insights 

Deliver executive-ready insights: Synthesize complex data into clear, concise narratives and recommendations for senior leaders 

Improve data quality and analytical rigor: Enhance data accuracy, reporting consistency, and analytical processes across pipeline, revenue, and GTM reporting

Collaborate on tools and systems: Partner with Sales Operations, Systems, and Analytics teams to ensure reliable tooling, dashboards, and scalable reporting foundations

 

Minimum Qualifications 
 

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Business Analytics, Finance, Economics, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience 

5+ years of experience in revenue operations, GTM analytics, strategy, management consulting, or a related analytical discipline 

Strong analytical skills with experience working with large, complex datasets 

Demonstrated ability to translate pipeline and revenue data into actionable insights and recommendations 

Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience working with CRM platforms such as Salesforce and similar

Strong communication and collaboration skills, including experience working with cross-functional stakeholders 

 

Preferred Qualifications 
 

Experience in SaaS, subscription, or recurring revenue business models 

Familiarity with forecasting, pipeline analytics, and revenue performance management. 

Experience building dashboards or working with BI and analytics tools 

Familiarity with pipeline inspection or forecasting platforms such as Clari and similar

Comfort operating in fast-paced, ambiguous, and matrixed environments 

Strong attention to detail combined with the ability to think strategically about business problems

Role Overview
The Senior Associate Renewal Representative, Regional Accounts (SR2) independently manages time and tasks to handle multiple renewal cycles, engaging in communication and negotiation activities with moderate guidance. The role supports customer satisfaction by identifying and addressing customer needs, provides light touch partner support, monitors churn risks, and ensures accurate and timely renewal execution. They leverage CRM systems to automate workflows and flag exceptions within established guidelines.

Key Responsibilities
Execute End to End Renewal Motions
• Independently execute full renewal workflows for assigned accounts.
Close Renewals
• Defend existing customer base by ensuring timely and accurate renewal execution with moderate guidance.
Drive and Close Seat Expansions
• Identify and close seat expansion opportunities (additional licenses across existing buyers, teams, or personas) using standard playbooks during renewal.
Monitor Auto Renewal Status
• Intervene when auto renewals are disabled to prevent churn, applying judgment within well defined guidelines.
Customer Procurement Interaction
• Work directly with customer procurement teams to ensure seamless renewal execution, operating with general instruction on routine tasks.

Skills & Competencies
• Organizational & Time Management: Manages multiple renewal cycles independently, with moderate guidance.
• Customer First Mindset: Identifies and addresses customer needs to drive satisfaction.
• Communication: Engages customers using clear, effective communication to secure renewals.
• Negotiation: Applies basic negotiation techniques to achieve mutual agreement on renewals.
• CRM & Workflow Systems: Utilizes CRM systems to automate workflows and flag exceptions.

ATU (Account Team Unit) Collaboration)
• Expansion Qualification: Engages Account Executives for larger cross sell or expansion opportunities with moderate guidance.
• Customer Success Collaboration: Provides light touch coordination with Customer Success Managers to support retention and adoption.
• Partner Engagement: Supports partners where applicable, following general instructions.
• Share Insights: Communicates churn risks, blockers, and missed upsell signals across teams and geographies.
• Feedback Loop: Provides feedback on product experiences and packaging based on customer insights.

Required Qualifications
• 2–3 years of experience in renewals, account management, customer success, inside sales, or a similar customer facing role.
• Experience managing renewal cycles or recurring revenue motions.
• Strong communication skills with the ability to influence customer decisions.
• Foundational negotiation skills with the ability to secure renewals or basic expansions.
• Ability to manage multiple concurrent workflows and adhere to renewal timelines.
• Proficiency using CRM systems and basic workflow automation.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience working in SaaS, subscription licensing, or recurring revenue commercial environments.
• Familiarity with procurement processes or vendor customer negotiation cycles.
• Exposure to partner led or channel supported sales motions.
• Experience identifying churn risks or upsell signals through customer conversations or data.
• Working knowledge of forecasting renewals or using dashboards for revenue tracking.
• Experience coordinating across sales, customer success, and partner teams.

Description du poste

Le département Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) Platform Data d'Autodesk recherche un architecte logiciel expérimenté.

À ce poste, vous serez chargé de concevoir et de développer les systèmes et services qui alimentent les capacités de données transversales au sein de notre organisation et leur intégration avec les produits AEC existants et futurs d'Autodesk.

Cette opportunité est faite pour vous si vous êtes passionné par la conception d'architectures de systèmes complexes et si vous êtes enthousiasmé par l'idée de transformer la manière dont les professionnels de l'AEC utilisent les données pour acquérir des connaissances, éclairer leurs décisions et mener à bien leurs projets.

En tant qu'architecte logiciel au sein de la plateforme de données AEC, vous serez à l'avant-garde de la conception de la prochaine génération de fonctionnalités pour Autodesk Forma Industry Cloud. Vous collaborerez avec les architectes logiciels de l'équipe de la plateforme de données AEC ainsi qu'avec les architectes logiciels des applications et services les plus avancés au monde pour la conception et la construction de bâtiments et d'infrastructures, notamment Revit, Civil 3D, AutoCAD, Autodesk Construction Cloud et Autodesk Forma. Vous définirez l'architecture logicielle qui réinvente le flux continu des données AEC (par exemple, les modèles 3D, les dessins 2D, le suivi des problèmes, les coûts, les flux de capteurs, etc.) et des informations tout au long du cycle de vie d'un actif construit, de la conception et la construction à l'exploitation et la maintenance. 

Il s'agit d'un poste individuel relevant de l'architecte distingué de l'équipe AEC Platform Data.

Responsabilités

Définir et faire évoluer l'architecture inter-équipes pour les plateformes et les services de données au sein de l'organisation AEC Platform Data

Établir des normes, des architectures de référence et des composants réutilisables ; encourager leur adoption par toutes les équipes de l'organisation AEC Platform Data

Diriger la gouvernance architecturale et les enregistrements des décisions architecturales (ADR) ; mener des revues de conception entre les équipes

Concevoir et guider la mise en œuvre de systèmes distribués et de plateformes de données (API, schémas, flux d'événements, batch et streaming)

Garantir la fiabilité, la sécurité et les performances ; définir les SLO et favoriser l'observabilité (métriques, traçabilité, journalisation)

Collaborer avec les équipes produits et plateformes de l'organisation AEC afin d'harmoniser les feuilles de route et les intégrations

Communiquer les architectures à l'aide de vues et de diagrammes clairs (par exemple, C4) et de descriptions adaptées aux cadres dirigeants

Qualifications minimales

Licence en informatique ou expérience équivalente

Plus de 10 ans d'expérience en tant qu'architecte logiciel dans des environnements cloud à forte intensité de données

Expérience des services cloud, de la conception d'API, de l'architecture de bases de données, des outils et des frameworks big data

Excellente compréhension des principes de modélisation, de gestion et de traitement des données

Excellente connaissance de la conception et de l'architecture de logiciels

Capacité avérée à influencer sans autorité et à favoriser l'alignement entre les équipes

Maîtrise de la transmission d'idées complexes de manière concise et percutante

Excellentes aptitudes à la communication verbale et écrite et à la présentation pour communiquer efficacement la stratégie d'architecture logicielle à divers intervenants

Capacité à collaborer avec une équipe internationale

Qualifications souhaitées

Expérience dans le secteur de l'architecture, de l'ingénierie et de la construction

Expérience des services cloud avec AWS fortement appréciée (EC2, ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, RDS)

Architecture et technologies de bases de données : Snowflake, relationnelle, NoSQL

Architectures événementielles et de streaming : Kafka ou Kinesis ; traitement « exactly-once » ; évolution des schémas (Avro/Protobuf)

Conception d'API et de services : REST, gRPC, GraphQL ; gestion des versions et rétrocompatibilité à grande échelle

Systèmes distribués et plateformes de données : microservices, maillage de services, architecture événementielle, traitement de streaming

Observabilité/SRE : OpenTelemetry, traçage distribué, métriques/SLO pour les services de données

Graphiques de connaissances/modélisation sémantique (un atout) : RDF/OWL, graphes de propriétés ou magasins de fonctionnalités pour le ML
